author: john-calvin
fields.title: Okugumiikiriza Okuyigganyizibwa olwa Kristo
fields.summary: Yabuulira ekkanisa eyali eyigganyizibwa: Kalivini agamba nti tewali n’omu abonaabona n’okugumiikiriza olw’Enjiri nga tasoose kukakasa nsonga, n’oluvannyuma n’akoowoola abakkiriza okufuluma “ebweru w’olusiisira” n’okwetikka ekivume kya Kristo—amaaso gaabwe nga gagalamidde ku kuzuukira, omuli essanyu lyabwe lyonna n’okuwangula.

study_questions.question: Lwaki Kalivini agamba nti obukakafu obw’okukkiriza busaana okusooka nga tetunnabonaabonera Kristo?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga "bwe tuyitibwa okuwaayo obulamu bwaffe, kya bwetaavu ddala okumanya ku nsonga ki gye tunywerera." Okuteeka obulamu "mu busalizo" bungu bwokka, so si buvumu; mu nsonga ennungi yokka, egumibwa n’obukakafu obutabuusabuusa, Katonda mw’atwatuliramu nga "abaffiira be."

study_questions.question: Kalivini akwasa atya abawuliriza be ensonyi olw’obutanyiikira bwabwe?
study_questions.answer: Ng’abageraageranya n’abaffiira ab’edda, abaamanya Ebyawandiikibwa bitono naye ne bafiira mu "bibinja" ebijjuvu olw’amazima matono ag’omusingi, ate nga "ffe... tuli bayigirize bagezigezi bwe batyo," nga tulina omusana ogusinga ogwa buli mulembe ogwabaawo—"ate oluvannyuma lwa byonna, tewali n’akatono k’obunyiikivu."

study_questions.question: Kalivini addamu atya okwemulugunya nti Katonda yandikuumye bulungi abantu be okuva mu kuyigganyizibwa?
study_questions.answer: Kristo ye kyokulabirako kyaffe, kale kiba "ssanyu kinene okufuulibwa okufaanana Ye"; era okukkiriza, okusinga zaabu omuwendo, kuteekwa "okugezesebwa mu muliro" (1 Peetero 1:7). Katonda ayagala Kristo afugire wakati mu balabe be, era abantu be bagabana embeera eyo okutuusa lw’anaabanunula.

study_questions.question: Bisuubizo ki ebisatu Kalivini by’awa okubudaabuda omuffiira?
study_questions.answer: Nti obulamu bwaffe n’okufa kwaffe biri ddala mu mukono gwa Katonda ("tewali luviiri... awatali kukkiriza kwe" — Danyeri, abaana abasatu, ne Peetero baanunulibwa); nti Omwoyo we alitunyweza abalabe baleme "okutuwangula" (omuvubuka ow’e Tournay: "Oyo alimpa ekisa okufa n’obugumiikiriza... ddala alimpa ekisa okugumira omuliro"); era nti amagoba kwe kukuŋŋaanyizibwa wamu ne Kristo mu kitiibwa ekitaggwaawo.

fields.body_html:
Okubuulirira kwonna kwe tuyinza okuweebwa okugumiikiriza olw’erinnya lya Yesu Kristo, n’okulwanirira Enjiri, tekugenda kutuyamba bwe tutaba na bukakafu ku nsonga gye tulwanirira. Kubanga bwe tuyitibwa okuwaayo obulamu bwaffe, kya bwetaavu ddala okumanya ku nsonga ki gye tunywerera. Obunywevu bwe twetaaga tetuyinza kubufuna, wabula nga bwesigamiziddwa ku bukakafu obw’okukkiriza.

Kituufu nti waliyo abantu abayinza okulabika, abeeteeka mu kufa mu busirusiru olw’okunywerera ku ndowooza enkyamu n’ebirooto ebyeyongera mu mitwe gyabwe bo, naye obwangu obwenkanidde awo businga kuyitibwa ddalu okusinga okunyiikira kwa Bukristo; era mazima, tewali bunywevu wadde amagezi mu abo abeekasuka bwe batyo mu bufunze awatali kulowooza. Kyokka, ka kibe bwe kityo, mu nsonga ennungi yokka Katonda mw’ayinza okututegeerera nga abaffiira be. Okufa kufa kwa buli muntu, era abaana ba Katonda basalirwa omusango gw’ensonyi n’okubonyaabonyezebwa nga bwe kiri eri abamenyi b’amateeka; naye Katonda abaawula, kubanga tayinza kwegaana mazima ge. Ku lwaffe, kyetaagisa nti tubeere n’obukakafu obw’amazima era obutayinza kulimba obw’enjigiriza gye tunywerera; noolwekyo, nga bwe njogedde, tetuyinza kuwuubaala mu magezi olw’okubuulirira kwe tuweebwa okugumiikiriza okuyigganyizibwa olw’Enjiri, bwe wataba bukakafu bwa kukkiriza obwawandiikiddwa mu mitima gyaffe. Kubanga okuteeka obulamu bwaffe mu kabi awatali bukakafu si kya buzaaliranwa, era ne bwe tukikola, kyandibadde bungu bwokka, so si buvumu bwa Bukristo. Mu kigambo kimu, tewali kye tukola kirisiimibwa Katonda bwe tutaba bakakasibbwa ddala nti tuyigganyizibwa ku lulwe n’olw’ensonga ye, era ng’ensi y’omulabe waffe.

Kaakano, bwe njogera ku bukakafu obwenkana awo, sitegeeza kwawula bwokka wakati w’eddiini ey’amazima n’obukyamu oba obusirusiru bw’abantu, naye era nti tuteekwa okukakasibwa ddala ku bulamu obw’omu ggulu, n’engule etusuubizibwa waggulu, oluvannyuma lw’okulwana wano wansi. Kale ka tutegeere nti ebyetaagisa byombi bya bwetaavu, era tebiyinza kwawukanyizibwa. Noolwekyo, ensonga gye tuteekwa okusookera kwe zino: Tuteekwa okumanya bulungi Obukristo bwaffe kye buli, okukkiriza kwe tuteekwa okukwata n’okugoberera kye kuli, n’etteeka Katonda ly’atuwadde kye liri; era tuteekwa okuba abagunjuddwa mu njigiriza eyo ne tusobola n’obuvumu okuvumirira obulimba, obukyamu, n’eddogo lyonna Setaani lye yaleeta okwonoona obutuukirivu obw’amazima obw’enjigiriza ya Katonda. Noolwekyo, tetusaana kwewuunya nti mu biro bino tulaba abantu batono ennyo abeetegese okubonaabonera Enjiri, era nti ekitundu ekisinga obungi ku abo abeeyita Abakristo tebamanyi kye kiri. Kubanga bonna, wamu nga bwe kiri, ba bunnyogovu; era mu kifo ky’okufuula ekyo omulimu gwabwe okuwuliriza oba okusoma, bamala okulowooza nti kimala okuba nga baakomba ku kukkiriza kwa Bukristo. Eyo y’ensonga lwaki waliyo obumalirivu obutono ennyo, era lwaki abo abalumbibwa amangu ago bagwa. Ekyo kitusaanira kutukubiriza kwekenneenya n’obunyiikivu obungi mu mazima ga Katonda, tulyoke tube abakakafu ddala ku gago.

Naye kyokka, okumanya obulungi n’okuba omunywevu si bwe bwonna obwetaavu. Kubanga tulaba abamu abalabika ng’abajjudde ddala enjigiriza entuufu, naye ate nga tebalina kunyiikira wadde okwagala kusinga abo abatamanyanga ku Katonda okuggyako endowooza empewuke. Lwaki bwe kiri bwe kityo? Kubanga tebategeeranga bukulu bw’Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu. Era mazima, singa ffe, nga bwe tuli, tulowooza bulungi nti Katonda ye yatwogerako, tekirina kubuusabuusa nti twandiwulirizza n’obwegendereza n’ekitiibwa ekisingako. Singa tulowooza nti bwe tusoma Ebyawandiikibwa tuli mu ssomero ery’abamalayika, twandibadde n’obwegendereza n’okwegomba okusingako okuganyulwa mu njigiriza etuweebwa.

Kaakano tulaba engeri entuufu ey’okwetegeka okubonaabonera Enjiri. Ekisooka, tuteekwa okuba nga twegendeddemu mu ssomero lya Katonda okutuusa lwe tumaliridde ku ddiini ey’amazima n’enjigiriza gye tuteekwa okunywerera; era tuteekwa okunyooma enkwe zonna n’obulimba bwa Setaani, n’ebyayiiya byonna eby’abantu, ng’ebintu ebitalimu makulu naye era eby’omubiri, kubanga byonoona obutuukirivu bwa Bukristo; nga bwe tutyo tuba twawukana, ng’abaffiira ba Kristo ab’amazima, ku bantu ab’endowooza empewuke ababonaabonera ebitalimu makulu. Ekyokubiri, nga tukakasibbwa ku nsonga ennungi, tuteekwa okwakira ddala olw’okugoberera Katonda buli gy’anaatuyita: Ekigambo kye kiteekwa okuba n’obuyinza obwenkana bwe kigwanira, era nga twekutudde ku nsi eno, tuteekwa okuwulira nga twekwaddwa mu kunoonya obulamu obw’omu ggulu.

Naye kya kwewuunya ennyo nti, wadde ng’omusana gwa Katonda gwaka bulungi okusinga bwe gwali gwaka edda, waliyo obutanyiikira obunakuwaza! Bwe kiba nga ekyo tekitukwasa nsonyi, kale ekibi kyeyongera. Kubanga mu bbanga eritali ly’ewala tugenda kujja mu maaso g’Omulamuzi omukulu, obutali butuukirivu bwe twagezaako okukweka gye buliyanjululirwa n’okunenyezebwa okunene ne tuswala ddala. Kubanga, oba nga tuwalirizibwa okuwa obujulizi eri Katonda, ng’ekigero ky’okumanya kw’atuwadde bwe kiri, ndaba kiki ekituleetera okuba abannyogovu era abatya bwe tuyingira mu lutalo, nga tulaba nga Katonda yeeyolese bw’atyo mu kiseera kino nga bw’ayinza okuyogerwako nti atuggulidde n’atwanjululizza obugagga obunene obw’ebyama bye? Tekiyinza kwogerwa nti tetulowooza nti tulina omulimu ne Katonda? Kubanga singa twassaayo omwoyo ku bukulu bwe, tetwandigumiikirizza kukyusa njigiriza eva gy’ali okugifuula engeri ey’okulowoozaamu okw’amagezi ag’ensi. Mu bufunze, tekiyinza kwegaanibwa nti kya nsonyi nnene, si kya kutwogerako busalizo bwa ntiisa, nti twamanya bulungi bwe tutyo amazima ga Katonda, ate ne tuba n’obuvumu obutono bwe butyo okugawagira!

Okusingira ddala byonna, bwe tutunuulira abaffiira ab’ebiro eby’edda, tusaana nnyo okukyawa obulyolyo bwaffe! Ekitundu ekisinga obungi ku abo tebaali bantu bamanyi nnyo Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu, ne basobola okuwakana ku nsonga zonna. Baamanya nti waliyo Katonda omu, gwe baateekwa okusinza n’okuweereza—nti baali banunulibbwa n’omusaayi gwa Yesu Kristo, balyoke bateeke obwesige bwabwe obw’obulokozi mu Ye ne mu kisa kye—era nti, ebyayiiya byonna eby’abantu nga bya bwerere era bya kasasiro, baali basaana okuvumirira okusinza ebifaananyi n’eddogo lyonna. Mu kigambo kimu, enjigiriza yaabwe mu bukulu yali bwe ti—Waliyo Katonda omu eyatonda ensi yonna, n’atulaga by’ayagala okuyita mu Musa ne bannabbi, era n’ekisembayo okuyita mu Yesu Kristo n’abatume be; era tulina Omununuzi omu yekka, eyatugula n’omusaayi gwe, era olw’ekisa kye gye tusuubira okulokolebwa: Ebifaananyi byonna eby’ensi bikolimiddwa, era bisaana okukyayibwa.

Nga balina enkola etaliimu nsonga ndala okuggyako zino, baagenda n’obuvumu mu muliro, oba mu ngeri endala yonna ey’okufa. Tebaagenda babiri babiri oba basatu basatu, naye mu bibinja ebinene, olwo omuwendo gw’abo abaagwa mu mikono gy’abafuzi ab’obukambwe nga tegukoma! Ffe, ku lwaffe, tuli bayigirize bagezigezi nga tewali asinga (bwe tutyo bwe tulowooza), era mazima, ku bikwata ku kumanya Ebyawandiikibwa, Katonda abitwanjululidde bwe kityo nga tewali mulembe gwabaddewo ogwaganyulwa bwe kityo. Wabula, oluvannyuma lwa byonna, tewali n’akatono k’obunyiikivu. Abantu bwe boolesa obutafaayo obwenkanidde awo, kirabika ng’abasunguwaza okuwoolerezebwa kwa Katonda.

Kale kiki ekyandikoleddwa okwongera obuvumu obw’amazima mu mitima gyaffe? Ekisooka, tulina okulowooza engeri okwatula okukkiriza kwaffe bwe kuli okw’omuwendo mu maaso ga Katonda. Tetumanyi bulungi engeri Katonda gy’akussaamu omuwendo, obanga obulamu bwaffe, obutali kantu, tubussaamu omuwendo omungi okusinga. Bwe kiba bwe kityo, twoleka obusirusiru obw’ekitalo. Tetuyinza kununula bulamu bwaffe nga tuwaayo okwatula kwaffe awatali kukkiriza nti tubussaamu omuwendo omungi okusinga ekitiibwa kya Katonda n’obulokozi bw’emyoyo gyaffe.

Omukafiiri yasobola okugamba nti "Kyali kya nnaku okununula obulamu ng’oleka ebintu byokka ebyaleeta obulamu okuba obw’okwegomba!" Naye kyokka ye n’abalala abaali nga ye tebaamanyanga nsonga ki abantu gye bateekerwa mu nsi, era lwaki babeeramu. Kituufu baamanya bimala okugamba nti abantu basaana okugoberera obulungi, okweyisa mu bwesimbu awatali kunenyezebwa; naye obulungi bwabwe bwonna bwali langi na mukka bwokka. Ffe tumanyi obulungi ekigendererwa ekikulu eky’obulamu kye kiri, kwe kugulumiza Katonda, alyoke abe ekitiibwa kyaffe. Bwe kitakolebwa bwe kityo, zitusanze! Era tetuyinza kweyongera kubeera balamu kaseera na kamu ku nsi awatali kwongera bikolimo ku mitwe gyaffe. Naye kyokka tetukwatibwa nsonyi kugula nnaku ntono okulwana wano wansi, nga twegaana obwakabaka obutaggwaawo olw’okwawukana ku Oyo gwe tuwanirirwa amaanyi mu bulamu.

Singa twabuuza abantu abasingira ddala obutamanya, si kwogera ku basinga obusirusiru mu nsi, lwaki babeera balamu, tebandiyanenye kuddamu kigambo nti kwe kulya, n’okunywa, n’okwebaka; kubanga bonna bamanyi nti baatondebwa olw’ekigendererwa ekiwaggulu era ekitukuvu. Kale kigendererwa ki kye tuyinza okuzuula okuggyako okuwa Katonda ekitiibwa, n’okwekkiriza okufugibwa Ye, ng’abaana bwe bafugibwa abazadde abalungi; olwo bwe tumala olugendo lw’obulamu buno obuvunda, tulyoke tuyingizibwe mu busika bwe obutaggwaawo? Ekyo kye kigendererwa ekikulu, weewaawo eky’obwomu. Bwe tutakissaako mwoyo, ne tumalirira ku bulamu obw’ensolo, obusinga okufa okw’emirundi olukumi obubi, kiki kye tuyinza okuwoza olw’okwewolereza kwaffe? Okuba omulamu awatali kumanya nsonga ki tekiri kya buzaaliranwa. Okugaana ensonga ze tubeerera abalamu, olw’okwegomba okusiruvu okuwummulako nnaku ntono, ze tugenda okumala mu nsi, nga twawukanye ku Katonda—simanyi ngeri ya kuyita busiru na ddalu bwe butyo!

Naye kubanga okuyigganyizibwa bulijjo kukalubo era kukaawa, ka tulowooze engeri n’obukodyo Abakristo gye bayinza okwenywezaamu n’okugumiikiriza, ne bawaayo obulamu bwabwe awatali kutya olw’amazima ga Katonda. Ekyawandiikibwa kye tusomye, bwe kitegeerekeka bulungi, kimala okutukubiriza okukola bwe tutyo. Omutume agamba nti, Kale naffe tufulume tulage gy’ali ebweru w’olusiisira nga twetisse ekivume kye. Ekisooka, atujjukiza nti, ne bwe ebitala byandibadde tebisowoddwa ku ffe wadde omuliro okukoleezebwa okutwokya, tetuyinza kwegatta ddala ku Mwana wa Katonda nga tukyasibiddwa mu nsi eno. Noolwekyo Omukristo, ne bw’aba mu kuwummula, bulijjo ateekwa okuba n’ekigere kimu nga akiyimusizza okutambula okugenda mu lutalo, so si ekyo kyokka, naye ateekwa okuba n’okwagala kwe nga kuggiddwa ku nsi, wadde omubiri gwe nga gukyabeera mu yo. Ka kibe nti mu kusooka kitulabika nga kikalubo, naye tuteekwa okumatizibwa ebigambo bya Pawulo (1 Basessaloniika 3), nti twayitibwa era ne tulondebwa okubonaabona. Nga ne bw’agambye nti, Bwe kutyo bwe kuli okubeera kwaffe ng’Abakristo; luno lwe lugendo lwe tuteekwa okuyitamu bwe twagala okugoberera Kristo.

Mu kiseera kye kimu, okusanyusa obunafu bwaffe n’okukendeeza ku kubonaabona n’ennaku okuyigganyizibwa kwe kuyinza okutuleetera, empeera ennungi eweereddwayo: Bwe tubonaabonera ensonga ya Katonda, tutambula kigere ku kigere nga tugoberera Omwana wa Katonda, era nga tumulina ng’omukulembeze waffe. Singa kyagambiddwa bwokka nti okuba Abakristo tuteekwa okuyita mu kuvvoolebwa kwonna okw’ensi n’obuvumu, okusisinkana okufa buli kiseera ne mu ngeri yonna Katonda gy’anaasiima, twandiyinzizza okuba n’ekigambo eky’okuddamu nti lugendo lwa kitalo okugenda mu busalizo. Naye bwe tulagirwa okugoberera Mukama Yesu, obukulembeze bwe bulungi era bwa kitiibwa nnyo okuba obw’okugaanibwa. Kaakano, tulyoke tunyeenyezebwe okusingako, si kyokka nti kigambibwa nti Yesu Kristo atukulembera ng’Omuduumizi waffe, naye era nti tufuulibwa okufaanana ekifaananyi kye; bw’atyo Pawulo bw’agamba mu ssuula ey’omunaana ey’Abaruumi nti Katonda yalagira abo bonna b’ayaza okuba abaana be okufuulibwa okufaanana Oyo ali kyokulabirako era omutwe gwa bonna.

Tuli abanafu bwe tutyo okutaagala kugumiikiriza kantu? Kale tuteekwa okwegaana ekisa kya Katonda kye yatuyitiramu eri essuubi ery’obulokozi. Kubanga waliyo ebintu bibiri ebitayinza kwawukanyizibwa—okuba ebitundu bya Kristo, n’okugezesebwa mu kubonaabona okungi. Mazima tusaana okussa omuwendo ku kufaanana Omwana wa Katonda okusinga bwe tukikola. Kituufu nti mu kusala omusango kw’ensi mulimu ensonyi mu kubonaabonera Enjiri. Naye kubanga tumanyi nti abakkiriza bazibe b’amaaso, tetusaana kuba n’amaaso amalungi okusinga bo? Kya nsonyi okubonaabonera abo abatudde ku ntebe ey’obwenkanya, naye Pawulo atulaga mu kyokulabirako kye nti tulina okwenyumiririza mu mbooko olwa Yesu Kristo, ng’obubonero Katonda bw’atumanyiramu era bw’atwatuliramu okuba ababe. Era tumanyi Lukka ky’ayogera ku Peetero ne Yokaana (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 5:41); nti baasanyuka olw’okubalibwa nga basaanira okubonaabona n’okuvumibwa olw’erinnya lya Mukama Yesu.

Ensonyi n’ekitiibwa bintu bibiri eby’enjawulo: bwe kityo ensi bw’eyogera, eyo, olw’okuba nga ya basiru, esala omusango ewakanya amagezi gonna, era mu ngeri eno ekyusa ekitiibwa kya Katonda okukifuula obuswavu. Naye ku lwaffe, tuleme okugaana okuvumibwa ku by’ensi, tulyoke tuweebwe ekitiibwa mu maaso ga Katonda ne bamalayika be. Tulaba obuzibu abaagala ebitiibwa bwe beeteesaako okufuna ebiragiro bya kabaka, n’engeri gye beenyumirizaamu. Omwana wa Katonda atuwa ebiragiro bye, naye buli omu adda ennyuma. Mbuuza, mulabe, obanga mu kukola bwe kityo tusaanira okuba n’ekintu kyonna ekifaanagana naye? Tewali kintu wano kisikiriza obuntu bwaffe obw’omubiri, naye kyokka ebyo bye bubonero bw’ekitiibwa obw’amazima obw’omu ggulu. Okusibibwa mu kkomera, obuwaŋŋanguse, okwogerwako obubi, mu ndowooza y’abantu bireeta ekyo kyonna ekivumibwa; naye kiki ekitulemesa okutunuulira ebintu nga Katonda bw’abisala era bw’abyogerako, okuggyako obutakkiriza bwaffe? Noolwekyo, ka erinnya ly’Omwana wa Katonda libe n’obuzito bwonna bwe ligwanira gye tuli, tulyoke tuyige okukibala ekitiibwa bw’atateeka obubonero bwe ku ffe. Bwe tukola bulala obutasiima bwaffe tebugumiikirizika.

Singa Katonda yatuyisa ng’okusaana kwaffe bwe kuli, tekyandibadde n’ensonga entuufu ey’okutukangavvula buli lunaku mu ngeri lukumi? Weewaawo n’okusingawo, okufa emitwalo kikumi tekyandimazeeko kitundu kitono eky’ebibi byaffe! Kaakano, bw’aba mu bulungi bwe obutaggwaawo ateeka ebibi byaffe byonna wansi w’ekigere kye n’abizikiriza, era mu kifo ky’okutubonereza ng’obubi bwaffe bwe buli, ayiiya engeri ey’ekitalo okukyusa okubonaabona kwaffe okukufuula ekitiibwa n’enkizo ey’enjawulo, kubanga okuyita mu kwo tuyingizibwa mu kussekimu n’Omwana we, tekyandiyogerwa, bwe tunyooma embeera ennungi bwe etyo, nti mazima twakulaakulana katono nnyo mu njigiriza ya Bukristo?

Noolwekyo, Peetero, bwe yamala okutukubiriza (1 Peetero 4:15) okutambula mu butuukirivu mu kutya Katonda, tuleme kubonaabona ng’ababbi, abenzi, n’abatemu, amangu ago ayongerako nti, bwe tuba tuteekwa okubonaabona ng’Abakristo, ka tugulumize Katonda olw’omukisa gw’atuwa bwe gutyo. Si kya bwereere ky’ayogera bw’atyo. Kubanga ffe ba ani, mbuuza, okuba abajulizi b’amazima ga Katonda, n’abawagizi okulwanirira ensonga ye? Wano tuli nvunyu enkole ez’ensi, ebitonde ebijjudde obutaliimu, ebijjudde obulimba, naye kyokka Katonda atukozesa okulwanirira amazima ge—ekitiibwa ekitatuuka na ku bamalayika ab’omu ggulu! Okulowooza kuno kwokka tekwandituleeteredde okwakira okwewaayo eri Katonda okukozesebwa mu ngeri yonna mu buweereza obw’ekitiibwa bwe butyo?

Wabula abantu bangi tebayinza kwerema kuwakanya Katonda, oba, okuli okwemulugunya gy’ali olw’obutawagira bulungi obunafu bwabwe. Kya kwewuunya nnyo, bwe bagamba, engeri Katonda, ng’amaze okutulonda okuba abaana be, gy’atuleka okulinnyirirwa n’okubonyaabonyezebwa aboonoonyi. Nziramu nti: Ne bwe kitandirabise lwaki akola bw’atyo, yandisobodde okukozesa obuyinza bwe ku ffe, n’assaawo omugabo gwaffe nga bwe yeeyagala. Naye bwe tulaba nti Yesu Kristo ye kyokulabirako kyaffe, tetusaanira, awatali kwongera kubuuza, okukibala kya ssanyu kinene okufuulibwa okufaanana Ye? Katonda, kyokka, akikakasa bulungi ensonga lwaki asiima ffe okuyigganyizibwa. Singa tetwabadde na kirala okuggyako ekyo Peetero kye yategeeza (1 Peetero 1:7), twandibadde banyoomi ddala okutakikkiriza. Agamba nti, kubanga zaabu ne ffeeza, ebiri ebyuma ebivunda bwokka, bitukuzibwa ne bigezesebwa mu muliro, kya bwenkanya nti okukkiriza kwaffe, okusinga obugagga bwonna obw’ensi, kugezesebwe bwe kityo.

Kyandibadde kyangu ddala eri Katonda okututtikira engule mu kaseera awatali kutwetaagisa kulwana ntalo zonna; naye nga bwe kiri okusiima kwe nti okutuusa ku nkomerero y’ensi Kristo afugire wakati mu balabe be, bwe kityo era kwe kusiima kwe nti ffe, nga tuteekeddwa wakati waabwe, tugumiikirize okunyigirizibwa n’obukambwe bwabwe okutuusa lw’anaatununula. Mmanyi, mazima, nti omubiri gujeema bwe guleeterwa ku nsonga eno, naye kyokka okwagala kwa Katonda kuteekwa okuwangula. Bwe tuwulira okuziyira mu ffe, tekitwewuunyisa; kubanga kya buzaaliranwa gye tuli okwewala omusaalaba. Naye kyokka tuleme kulemererwa kugusukkuluma, nga tumanyi nti Katonda akkiriza obuwulize bwaffe, obanga tuleeta enneewulira n’okwegomba kwaffe kwonna mu buwambe ne tubifuula eby’okugonda gy’ali.

Bannabbi n’abatume bwe baagenda mu kufa, tekyali awatali kuwulira akayagalira ak’okuziyira. "omuntu omulala n’akusiba n’akutwala gy’otoyagala." Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo bwe yagamba Peetero. (Yokaana 21:18.) Okutya okw’okufa bwe kuvaayo mu ffe, ka tukuwangule, oba okusinga awo ka Katonda akuwangule; ate mu kiseera kye kimu, ka tukakase nti tumuwa ssaddaaka esanyusa bwe tuziyiza ne tunyiga enneegombera zaffe olw’okwewaayo ddala mu buyinza bwe: Guno gwe lutalo olusinga Katonda lw’ayagala abantu be okwenyigiramu. Ayagala okubalwanyisa okumalawo buli ndowooza n’enneewulira eyeejeemu eyandibaggya ku kkubo ly’abalaga. Era essanyu weeriri lingi nnyo n’okuyinza kigambibwe nti, tuli bati ate n’okusingawo bwe tuggwaamu amaanyi!

Mu biro eby’edda abantu bangi ennyo, okufuna engule ennyangu ey’amakoola, tebaagaana kutegana, kubonaabona, wadde kuzibuwalirwa; weewaawo n’okufa tekyabakaluubirira, ate nga buli omu ku bo yalwanira mu busalizo, nga tamanyi oba agenda kuwangula oba okufiirwa empeera. Katonda atuwa engule etaggwaawo, gye tuyinza okuyita ne tugabana ekitiibwa kye: Tayagala tulwanire mu busalizo, naye ffenna tulina okusuubizibwa empeera gye tulwanira. Kale tulina ensonga ki ey’okugaana okulwana? Tulowooza nti kyayogerwa bwereere nti bwe tufiira wamu ne Yesu Kristo era tulibeera balamu wamu naye? Okuwangula kwaffe kutegekeddwa, ate nga tukola byonna bye tuyinza okwewala olutalo.

Naye kigambibwa nti byonna bye tuyigiriza ku nsonga eno biwakanya okusala kw’abantu. Nkiryaanya. Era noolwekyo Omulokozi waffe bw’alangirira nti, "Balina omukisa abayigganyizibwa olw’obutuukirivu" (Matayo 5:10), awa endowooza etakkirizibwa mangu mu nsi. Wabula, ayagala okubala ekyo ng’essanyu, ekiri mu kusala kw’amagezi ag’omubiri nga bunaku. Twerabira nga tuli banaku Katonda bw’atuleka okulinnyirirwa obufuzi obukambwe n’obukyayi bw’abalabe baffe; naye ensobi eri nti tetutunuulira bisuubizo bya Katonda, ebitukakasa nti byonna birifuuka okulungi kwaffe. Tuggwaamu amaanyi bwe tulaba ababi nga batusinga amaanyi, era nga bateeka ekigere kyabwe ku mumiro gwaffe; naye okutabukatabuka okwo kusaana, nga Pawulo bw’agamba, kutuleetere okuyimusa emitwe gyaffe. Kubanga tuli abeetegefu okumalako ebiseera mu bintu ebiriwo kaakano, Katonda mu kukkiriza ababi okufuga, n’abalungi okubonyaabonyezebwa, alaga n’obubonero obulabika nti waliyo olunaku olujja lwe byonna ebiri mu kutabukatabuka kaakano birituusibwa mu ntegeka. Bwe kitulabika ekiseera nga kya wala, ka tudduke eri eddagala, so si okwewaanawaana mu kibi kyaffe; kubanga kya lwatu nti tetulina kukkiriza bwe tutasobola kutunuula mu maaso okutuuka ku kujja kwa Yesu Kristo.

Okuleka awatali kukozesa buli kintu ekiyinza okutunyiiza, Katonda atuteekera mu maaso ebisuubizo ku ludda olumu n’entiisa ku ludda olulala. Bwe tuwulira nti ebisuubizo tebirina buyinza bumala, ka tubinyweze nga tubyongerako entiisa. Kituufu tuteekwa okuba abakyamu ennyo obutassa bwesige mungi mu bisuubizo bya Katonda, Mukama Yesu bw’agamba nti alitwatulira mu maaso ga Kitaawe, obanga tumwatulira mu maaso g’abantu. (Matayo 10:32; Lukka 12:8.) Kiki ekyanditulemesezza okwatula kw’atwetaagisa? Ka abantu bakole kye basobola okusingayo, tebayinza kukola kubi kusinga kututta! Ate obulamu obw’omu ggulu tebuligyawo kino? Wano sikuŋŋaanya byonna ebiwandiiko ebiri mu Byawandiikibwa ebikwata ku nsonga eno: biddirwamu emirundi mingi ne kitusaanira okumatizibwa nabyo ddala. Olutalo bwe lujja, oba ebiwandiiko bisatu oba bina bwe bitakumala, ekikumi kizanya kitusaana okutufuula abanywevu eri okukemebwa kwonna okuwakana.

Naye oba nga Katonda tayinza kutusika gy’ali mu ngeri ennungi, tetuba nga mabaati bwe n’entiisa ye bw’egaana okutukwatako? Yesu Kristo ayita abo bonna abanaaba beegaanye amazima olw’okutya okufa okw’ekiseera okujja mu maaso ga Katonda Kitaawe, era agamba nti olwo omubiri n’omwoyo biriweebwayo mu kuzikirira. (Matayo 10:28; Lukka 12:5.) Ate mu kifo ekirala agamba nti alyegaana abo bonna abanaaba beemulugunyizza okumwegaana mu maaso g’abantu. (Matayo 10:33; Lukka 12:10.) Ebigambo bino, bwe tutaba nga tetuwulira ddala, byandisobodde okuyimusa enviiri zaffe. Ka kibe bwe kityo, ekyo kikakafu; ebintu bino bwe bitatunyeenya nga bwe kigwanidde, tewali kitusigaddeyo okuggyako omusango ogw’entiisa. (Abaebbulaniya 10:27.) Ebigambo bya Kristo byonna bwe biba nga tebigasa, tusigala nga tukakasibbwa obutakkiriza obw’amaanyi.

Kya bwereere okuwoza nti tusaana okulaga ekisa, kubanga obuntu bwaffe bunafu nnyo; kubanga kigambibwa, mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, nti Musa, bwe yatunuulira Katonda olw’okukkiriza, yanywezebwa n’atagonda ku kukemebwa kwonna. Noolwekyo, bwe tuba abagonvu era ab’okugonda amangu, kabonero ka lwatu, sigamba nti tetulina bunyiikivu, wadde obunywevu, wabula nti tetumanyi kimu ku Katonda wadde obwakabaka bwe. Bwe tujjukizibwa nti tusaana okwegatta ku Mutwe gwaffe, kitulabika ng’ekyokwewolereza ekirungi okugamba nti tuli bantu. Naye baali baani abo abaakulembera mu kkubo? Mazima, singa tetwabadde na kirala okuggyako enjigiriza entuukirivu, ebyokwewolereza byaffe byonna byandibadde bya bwereere; naye nga tulina ebyokulabirako bingi bwe bityo ebyandituwadde obukakafu obusinga amaanyi, tusingirawo okusalirwa omusango.

Waliyo ensonga bbiri ez’okulowoozebwako. Ensooka eri nti, omubiri gwonna ogw’Ekkanisa awamu bulijjo gubaddewo, era okutuusa ku nkomerero gulibaawo, nga guyinza okubonyaabonyezebwa aboonoonyi, nga bwe kigambibwa mu Zabbuli (Zabbuli 129:1), "Bambonyaabonyezza nnyo okuva mu buvubuka bwange, ne bayisa ekyuma ekirima ku mugongo gwange okuva ku ludda olumu okutuuka ku lulala." Omwoyo Omutukuvu awo aleeta Ekkanisa eya edda, tulyoke, nga tumaze okumanya bulungi okubonaabona kwayo, tuleme okukibala nga kipya oba ekitunyiiza bwe kituukibwa ku ffe mu biro bino. Pawulo, era, ng’ajuliza mu Zabbuli endala (Abaruumi 8:36; Zabbuli 44:22), ekigambo ekigamba nti, "tubalibwa ng’endiga ez’okusalibwa," alaga nti ekyo tekyabaawo mu mulembe gumu gwokka, naye kwe kubeera kwa buli kiseera okw’Ekkanisa, era bwe kiribeera.

Noolwekyo, bwe tulaba engeri Ekkanisa ya Katonda gy’erinnyirirwa mu biro bino ab’ensi ab’amalala, engeri omu gy’aboggolera n’omulala okuluma, engeri gye babonyaabonya, gye bagisalira enkwe, gye erumbibwa obutakoma embwa ez’eddalu n’ensolo enkambwe, ka kitujjukize nti ekintu kye kimu kyakolebwa mu biro byonna eby’edda. Kituufu Katonda oluusi agiwa akaseera k’okuwummulako, era noolwekyo mu Zabbuli eyogeddwako waggulu kigambibwa nti, "amenyeemenye enjegere z’abakola ebibi," ne mu kifo ekirala (Zabbuli 125:3), "Kubanga abafuzi abakola ebibi tebalifugira mu nsi y’abatuukirivu, baleme okuwaliriza abatuukirivu okukola ebibi." Naye kyokka kimusanyusizza nti Ekkanisa ye bulijjo ebeere n’okulwana ng’ekyali mu nsi eno, okuwummula kwayo nga kuterekeddwa waggulu mu ggulu. (Abaebbulaniya 3:9.)

Mu kiseera kye kimu, enkomerero y’okubonaabona kwayo bulijjo ebadde nnungi. Mu byonna, Katonda akoze nti wadde ng’enyigirizibbwa emitawaana mingi, tereeyerwaako ddala; nga bwe kigambibwa (Zabbuli 7:15), "Asima ekinnya, n’akiwanvuya nnyo; ate n’akigwamu ye kye yasimye." Pawulo yeenyumiririza mu kino, era alaga nti luno lwe lugendo Katonda mu kusaasira lw’akwata bulijjo. Agamba (1 Abakkolinso 4:12) nti tugumiikiriza ennaku, naye tetunyigirizibwa ddala; tufuuka abaavu, naye tetulekebwa awatali kantu; tuyigganyizibwa, naye tetulekebwa; tusuulibwa wansi, naye tetuzikirira; nga twetisse buli wamu mu mibiri gyaffe okufa kwa Mukama Yesu, obulamu bwe bulyoke bulabisibwe mu mibiri gyaffe egifa. Nga bwe kityo bwe kuli, nga bwe tulaba, enkomerero Katonda gy’awadde buli kiseera okuyigganyizibwa kw’Ekkanisa ye, tusaana okwakira, nga tumanyi nti bajjajjaffe, abaali bantu abanafu nga ffe, bulijjo baawangula abalabe baabwe olw’okusigala nga banywevu mu kugumiikiriza.

Nkoma kutuukirira ku nsonga eno mu bufunze ndyoke ntuuke ku nsonga ey’okubiri, esinga okukwata ku kigendererwa kyaffe, kwe kuti, tusaana okuganyulwa mu byokulabirako eby’enjawulo eby’abaffiira abaatukulembera. Bino tebikoma ku babiri oba basatu, naye biri, ng’omutume bw’agamba (Abaebbulaniya 12:1), "ekibiina ekinene eky’abajulirwa ekyenkana awo." Mu bigambo bino ategeeza nti omuwendo munene nnyo ne gusaana, wamu nga bwe kiri, okutwaliira ddala amaaso gaffe gonna. Nneme okukooya, nzija kwogera ku Bayudaaya bokka, abaayigganyizibwa olw’eddiini ey’amazima, nga bwe kityo wansi w’obufuzi obukambwe obwa Kabaka Antiyokusi, ne katono oluvannyuma lw’okufa kwe. Tetuyinza kuwoza nti omuwendo gw’ababonaabona gwali mutono, kubanga gwakola, wamu nga bwe kiri, eggye ery’abaffiira. Tetuyinza kugamba nti gwakomawo ku bannabbi Katonda be yali ayawudde ku bantu abaabulijjo, kubanga abakazi n’abaana abato baali kitundu ky’ekibinja. Tetuyinza kugamba nti baawona ku muwendo mutono, kubanga baabonyaabonyezebwa n’obukambwe nga bwe kyasoboka. Noolwekyo, tuwulira omutume ky’agamba (Abaebbulaniya 11:35), nti abamu baagololebwa ng’engoma, nga tebafaayo kununulibwa, balyoke bafune okuzuukira okusingako obulungi; abalala baagezesebwa n’okuduula n’okukubibwa, oba ebisiba n’amakomera; abalala baakubibwa amayinja oba baasalibwa n’emisumeeno; abalala baatambula waggulu ne wansi, nga bawulukuka mu nsozi ne mu mpuku.

Ka kaakano tugeraageranye embeera yaabwe n’eyaffe. Oba baagumiikiriza bwe batyo olw’amazima agaali edda nga tegannaba kutegeerekeka bulungi, kiki kye tusaana okukola mu musana ogwaka kaakano? Katonda ayogera naffe n’akamwa akaggule; oluggi olunene olw’obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu lugguddwawo, era Yesu Kristo atuyita gy’ali, ng’amaze okuserengeta gye tuli tulyoke tumufune, wamu nga bwe kiri, ng’ali mu maaso gaffe. Kya nsonyi ki gye tuli okuba n’obunyiikivu obutono mu kubonaabonera Enjiri okusinga abo abaali balabidde ebisuubizo wala bwokka—abaali bagguliddwawo akaggi akatono okuyita mu ko okutuuka ku bwakabaka bwa Katonda, era abaalina ekijjukizo n’ekyokulabirako kya Yesu Kristo kyokka? Ebintu bino tebiyinza kwogerwa mu kigambo kimu, nga bwe bisaanira, era noolwekyo nleka buli omu okubirowoozaako yekka.

Enjigiriza eyanjuddwa kaakano, olw’okuba nga ya bulijjo, esaana okukolebwako Abakristo bonna, nga buli omu agirambika mu bulamu bwe nga bwe kyetaagisa. Kino nkyogera, abo abatalaba nga bali mu kabi akalabika balyoke baleme okukibala ng’ekitagasa gye bali. Kaakano tebali mu mikono gy’abafuzi ab’obukambwe, naye bamanyi batya Katonda ky’agenda okubakolako mu maaso? Noolwekyo tusaana okuba abeetegefu bwe tutyo nti bwe kunajja okuyigganyizibwa kwe tutaali tusuubidde, tuleme okukwatibwa nga tetweteeseteese. Naye ntya nnyo nti waliyo amatu amangi amaggavu ku nsonga eno. Abo abali mu bukuumi ne mu mirembe bali wala bwe batyo ku kwetegeka okufa nga kyetaagisa, ne batafaayo n’okuweereza Katonda mu bulamu bwabwe. Naye kyokka kisigala nga kya mazima nti okwetegeka kuno okw’okuyigganyizibwa kusaana okuba omulimu gwaffe ogwa bulijjo, na ddala mu biseera bino bye tubeeramu.

Ate abo Katonda b’ayita okubonaabonera obujulizi bw’erinnya lye basaana okulaga mu bikolwa nti baatendekebwa ddala mu kugumiikiriza. Olwo basaana okujjukira okubuulirira kwonna kwe baaweebwa mu biro eby’edda, ne beenyeenya nga bwe kityo omuserikale bw’afubutuka eri ebyokulwanyisa ng’omuyaga gukoona. Naye enkomerero ya njawulo nnyo. Ekibuuzo kyokka kwe kuzuula obukodyo bw’okwewala. Kino nkyogera ku kitundu ekisinga obungi; kubanga okuyigganyizibwa kwe kugezesa okw’amazima Katonda kw’akozesa okumanya abaabe. Era abasajja abesigwa ku beetegese okusisinkana okufa n’obuvumu batono nnyo.

Kya kitalo kya ntiisa, nti abantu abeenyumiririza mu kuba n’akatono k’Enjiri bayinza okwasama emimwa gyabwe ne boogera ebigambo ebiwakanya bwe bityo. Abamu baligamba nti, Tuganyulwa ki mu kwatula okukkiriza kwaffe eri abantu abakakanyavu abamaze okusalawo okulwanyisa Katonda? Kino si kusuula bugagga mu maaso g’embizzi? Nga Yesu Kristo teyalangirira lwatu (Makko 8:38) nti ayagala okwatulwa wakati mu babi n’ababi ennyo. Bo bwe batayigirizibwa, wamu nga bwe kiri, balisigala nga baswazizza; era noolwekyo okwatula kwa kaloosa akawooma mu maaso ga Katonda, ne bwe kuba nga kutta eri abaawakanyibwa. Waliyo abamu abagamba nti, Okufa kwaffe kunaaganyula ki? Tekulisooka kufuuka nkonge? Nga Katonda yabaleka okulonda okufa lwe banaakiraba nga kirungi ne bafuna ekiseera ekisaanidde. Wabula ffe, tukakasa obuwulize bwaffe nga tuleka mu mukono gwe amagoba agagenda okuva mu kufa kwaffe.

Ekisooka, kale, omuntu Omukristo, buli gy’anaabeera, ateekwa okusalawo, wadde ng’awo waliwo obulabe oba entiisa, okutambula mu bwesimbu nga Katonda bw’alagidde. Ka yeekuume nga bw’asobola okuva mu kuluma kw’emisege, naye tekiba na bukujjukujju bw’omubiri. Okusingira ddala byonna, ka ateeke obulamu bwe mu mikono gya Katonda. Akikoze?

Kale bw’agwa mu mikono gy’abalabe, ka alowooze nti Katonda, olw’okuteekateeka bw’atyo, asiimye okumufuula omu ku bajulirwa b’Omwana we, era noolwekyo talina ngeri ya kudda nnyuma awatali kumenya bwesigwa eri Oyo gwe twasuubiza obuwulize bwonna mu bulamu ne mu kufa—Oyo gwe tuli ababe era be tuli, wadde nga tetwakola ndagaano yonna.

Nga njogera kino, sisuula bonna wansi w’obwetaavu obw’okwatula ddala buli kimu kye bakkiriza, wadde nga bandiwalirizibwa okukola bwe batyo. Mmanyi era ekigero Pawulo kye yakwata, wadde nga tewaali muntu eyali amaliridde okusingawo okulwanirira ensonga y’Enjiri nga bw’asaana. Era noolwekyo si kya bwereere Mukama waffe bw’atusuubiza okutuwa, ku mukisa ng’ogwo, "ebigambo n’amagezi" (Lukka 21:15); nga ne bw’agambye nti, omulimu gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu si kutunyweza bwokka okuba abavumu era ab’amaanyi, naye era n’okutuwa amagezi n’okwawula, okutuluŋŋamya mu kkubo eryandigasa okukwata.

Ensonga ennene ey’ekyo kyonna eri nti, abo abali mu nnaku ng’eyo basaana okusaba ne bafuna amagezi ng’ago okuva waggulu, nga tebagoberera magezi gaabwe ag’omubiri, mu kunoonya ekituli kye banaayitamu okuwona. Waliyo abamu abatugamba nti Mukama waffe yennyini teyaddamu abo abaamubuuza. Naye nziramu, Ekisooka, nti kino tekiggyawo tteeka lye yatuwa okwatula okukkiriza kwaffe bwe tunaawalirizibwa. (1 Peetero 3:15.) Ekyokubiri, nti teyakozesa buwaŋŋanguse bwonna okuwonya obulamu bwe: era, Ekyokusatu, nti teyaddamu kuddamu kwabuusabuusa bwe kityo obutakwatamu bujulizi bumala ku byonna bye yalina okwogera; era, okugatta ku ekyo, yali amaze okumatiza abo abajja okumubuuza omulundi omulala, si kufuna bumanyirivu, naye okumutega emitego okumukwata.

Ka kinywezebwe, kale, ng’ensonga enkakafu mu Bakristo bonna, nti tebasaana kussa mu bulamu bwabwe omuwendo omungi okusinga obujulizi obw’amazima, kubanga Katonda ayagala okugulumizibwa mu bwo. Kya bwereere okuba nga awa erinnya ery’abajulirwa (kubanga kino kye kitegeeza ekigambo omuffiira) eri abo bonna abalina okuddamu mu maaso g’abalabe b’okukkiriza? Si kubanga yayagala okubakozesa olw’ekigendererwa ng’ekyo? Wano buli omu tasaana kunoonya munne, kubanga Katonda tawa kitiibwa bonna mu ngeri y’emu ku kuyita. Era nga bwe tuli abeetegefu okutunula bwe tutyo, tuteekwa okwegendereza okusingawo. Peetero, bwe yamala okuwulira ku mimwa gya Mukama waffe Yesu (Yokaana 21:18) nti alikulemberwa mu bukadde bwe gy’atayagala, yabuuza, Munne Yokaana kirimutuukako ki? Tewali n’omu ku ffe atandyanguyiriza kubuuza kibuuzo kye kimu; kubanga endowooza evaayo mangu mu mutwe gwaffe eri, Lwaki nze mbonaabona okusinga abalala? Wabula, Yesu Kristo akubiriza ffenna awamu, era buli omu ku ffe mu bwe bwannannyini, okwesiba "abeetegefu," olwo nga bw’anaayita ono oba ono, tulyoke tufulume mu mulundi gwaffe.

Nnyonnyodde waggulu engeri gye tutaabe beetegese okubonaabonera obuffiira, bwe tutaba twambadde ebisuubizo bya Katonda. Kaakano kisigadde okulaga obulungi obungi ekigendererwa n’ekiruubirirwa eby’ebisuubizo bino—si kubyogera byonna kinnakimu, naye okulaga ebintu ebikulu Katonda by’ayagala tusuubire okuva gy’ali, okutubudaabuda mu kubonaabona kwaffe. Kaakano ebintu bino, mu bufunze, bisatu. Ekisooka kiri nti, olw’okuba nga obulamu bwaffe n’okufa kwaffe biri mu mukono gwe, alitukuuma n’amaanyi ge nti tewali luviiri na lumu lulikuulibwa ku mitwe gyaffe awatali kukkiriza kwe. Noolwekyo abakkiriza basaana okukakasibwa nti buli mikono gye banaagwamu, Katonda taggyibwako bukuumi bw’akola ku bantu baabwe. Singa okukakasa okwo kwawandiikibwa bulungi mu mitima gyaffe, twandinunuddwa ku kitundu ekisinga obungi eky’okubuusabuusa n’okweraliikirira okututawaanya n’okutuziyiza mu buvunaanyizibwa bwaffe.

Tulaba abafuzi ab’obukambwe nga basumuluddwa: awo kitulabika nga Katonda takyalina ngeri yonna ya kutulokola, ne tukemebwa okwerabirira ebyaffe nga tewali kirala kye tusuubira okuva gy’ali. Wabula, obulabirizi bwe, nga bw’abwanjuluza, busaana okutunuulirwa ffe ng’ekigo ekitawangulika. Kale tufube okuyiga amakulu gonna ag’ekigambo nti, emibiri gyaffe giri mu mikono gy’Oyo eyagitonda. Olw’ensonga eno oluusi yalokola abantu be mu ngeri ey’ekyamagero, ne yasukka ku kusuubira kw’abantu kwonna, nga Saddulaaki, Mesaki, ne Abdenego, okuva mu kyokero ky’omuliro, Danyeri okuva mu mpuku y’empologoma, Peetero okuva mu kkomera lya Kerode, gye yali asibiddwa, ng’asibiddwa enjegere, era ng’akuumiddwa nnyo. Mu byokulabirako bino yayagala okutegeeza nti akwata abalabe baffe, wadde nga tekirabika bwe kityo, era alina obuyinza okutuggya wakati mu kufa lw’anaayagala. Si nti bulijjo akikola; naye ng’akuumira obuyinza gy’ali okututeekateeka olw’obulamu n’olw’okufa, ayagala tuwulire nga tukakasibbwa ddala nti atukuuma; olwo buli abafuzi ab’obukambwe kye banaagezaako, era n’obusungu bwonna bwe banaatulumbisa nabwo, ye yekka alina obuyinza okuteekateeka obulamu bwaffe.

Bw’akkiriza abafuzi ab’obukambwe okututta, si kubanga obulamu bwaffe tebumwagala, era nga tabussaamu muwendo emirundi kikumi ogusinga bwe gusaana. Kubanga bwe kiri bwe kityo, ng’ayogeredde mu kamwa ka Dawudi (Zabbuli 116:15) nti okufa kw’abatukuvu kwa muwendo mu maaso ge, ayogera era mu kamwa ka Isaaya (Isaaya 26:21) nti ensi erikwekula omusaayi ogulabika ng’ogukwekeddwa. Kale abalabe b’Enjiri ka basaasaanye nga bwe baagala omusaayi gw’abaffiira, balina okuvunaanyizibwa okw’entiisa ku gwo okutuuka ku ttondo lyagwo ery’enkomerero. Mu biro bino, beeyagaza mu kunyooma nga bawaayo abakkiriza mu muliro; era bwe bamala okunaaba mu musaayi gwabwe, batamiira ku gwo okutuusa lwe babala okutta kwonna kwe bakola ng’ezannyo lya masanyu bulyo. Naye bwe tugumiikiriza okulinda, Katonda alirage ku nkomerero nti si kya bwereere yasala obulamu bwaffe ku muwendo ogwa waggulu bwe gutyo. Mu kiseera kye kimu, kireme okutunyiiza nti kirabika ng’okikakasa Enjiri, eyo mu muwendo esinga eggulu n’ensi.

Okusingako okukakasibwa nti Katonda tatuleka nga twerabiddwa mu mikono gy’abafuzi ab’obukambwe, ka tujjukire ebigambo bya Yesu Kristo, bw’agamba (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 9:4) nti Ye yennyini ayigganyizibwa mu bitundu bye. Katonda mazima yagamba edda (Zekkaliya 2:8) nti, "anaabakwatako anaaba akutte ku mmunye ya liiso lye." Naye wano kigambibwa bulungi ennyo, nti bwe tubonaabonera Enjiri, kiba kifaanana ng’Omwana wa Katonda ye yennyini abonaabonera mu mubiri gwe. Kale ka tumanye nti Yesu Kristo ateekwa okwerabira yekka nga tannaba kulekera okutulowoozaako bwe tuba mu kkomera, oba mu kabi k’okufa olw’ensonga ye; era ka tumanye nti Katonda alissa ku mutima okuvumibwa kwonna abafuzi ab’obukambwe kwe batukolako, wamu nga bwe kiri, ng’akukoleddwa ku Mwana we yennyini.

Ka kaakano tutuuke ku nsonga ey’okubiri Katonda gy’atulangirira mu kisuubizo kye olw’okutubudaabuda. Eri nti, alitunyweza n’amaanyi g’Omwoyo we bwe kityo nti abalabe baffe, ka bakole kye basobola, wadde nga Setaani y’akulembeddemu, tebaligobamu wamu gye tuli. Era tulaba engeri gy’ayoleka ebirabo bye mu kiseera eky’obulabe ng’ekyo; kubanga obunywevu obutawangulika obulabika mu baffiira bulaga bulungi era mu bujjuvu nti Katonda akola mu bo n’amaanyi. Mu kuyigganyizibwa waliyo ebintu bibiri ebizibuwalira omubiri, okuvumibwa n’okunyoomebwa kw’abantu, n’ebibonyoobonyo omubiri bye gubonaabona. Kaakano, Katonda asuubiza okutugololera omukono gwe bwe kityo mu bujjuvu, nti tunaawangula byombi olw’okugumiikiriza. Ekyo ky’atugamba akikakasa n’ebikolwa. Kale ka tukwate engabo eno okuziyiza okutya kwonna kwe tulumbibwa, era tuleme okuziyiza omulimu gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu nsalo enfunda bwe zityo ne tulowooza nti taliwangula mangu obukambwe bwonna obw’abantu.

Ku kino twafuna, mu byokulabirako ebirala, ekimu ekijjukirwa ennyo. Omuvubuka eyabeerera wano naffe, bwe yakwatibwa mu kibuga Tournay, yasalirwa omusango okusalibwa omutwe singa yeegaana, n’okwokebwa ng’omulamu singa asigala nga munywevu ku kigendererwa kye. Bwe yabuuzibwa kye yali agenda okukola, yaddamu bwereere nti, "Oyo alimpa ekisa okufa n’obugumiikiriza olw’erinnya lye, ddala alimpa ekisa okugumira omuliro." Tusaana okutwala ebigambo bino, si nga bya muntu wa lususu, naye nga bya Mwoyo Omutukuvu, okutukakasa nti Katonda talina buyinza butono okutunyweza n’okutufuula abawanguzi ku bibonyoobonyo, okusinga okutufuula okugonda mu kwagala eri okufa okusinga obukalubo. Ate era emirundi mingi tulaba obunywevu bw’awa aboonoonyi ababonaabonera ebibi byabwe. Sigamba ku bakakanyavu, naye ku abo abaggya okubudaabudibwa mu kisa kya Yesu Kristo, era olw’obuyambi bwe, n’omutima ogutereevu, ne bagumira ekibonyoobonyo ekisingayo obukambwe kye bayinza okuweebwa. Ekyokulabirako ekirungi kirabika mu mubbi eyakyusibwa ku kufa kwa Mukama waffe. Katonda, akola bw’atyo n’amaanyi ng’ayamba aboonoonyi abaavu bwe bagumira ekibonerezo eky’ebibi byabwe, alifuuka omubi bw’atyo eri abantu be, nga balwanira ensonga ye, obutabawa buvumu obutawangulika?

Ensonga ey’okusatu ey’okulowoozebwako mu bisuubizo Katonda by’awa abaffiira be, kwe kubala amagoba ge basaana okusuubira okuva mu kubonaabona kwabwe, era ku nkomerero, bwe kinaaba kyetaagisa, okuva mu kufa kwabwe. Kaakano, amagoba gano gali nti oluvannyuma lw’okugulumiza Erinnya lye—oluvannyuma lw’okuzimba Ekkanisa olw’obunywevu bwabwe—balikuŋŋaanyizibwa wamu ne Mukama Yesu mu kitiibwa kye ekitaggwaawo. Naye nga bwe twogedde ku kino waggulu mu bujjuvu, kimala wano okukijjukira. Kale ka abakkiriza bayige okuyimusa emitwe gyabwe eri engule ey’ekitiibwa n’obutaggwaawo Katonda gy’abayita, balyoke baleme okuwulira nga bagayaavu okuva mu bulamu buno olw’empeera ng’eyo; era, okukakasibwa ddala ku mukisa guno ogutagerageranyizika, ka babeere bulijjo n’okufaanana kwe balina eri Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo mu maaso gaabwe; nga batunuulira okufa wakati mu bulamu, nga Ye, olw’okuvumibwa okw’omusaalaba, bwe yatuuka ku kuzuukira okw’ekitiibwa, omuli essanyu lyaffe lyonna, n’okujaguza, n’okuwangula.
fields.body_text: Okubuulirira kwonna kwe tuyinza okuweebwa okugumiikiriza olw’erinnya lya Yesu Kristo, n’okulwanirira Enjiri, tekugenda kutuyamba bwe tutaba na bukakafu ku nsonga gye tulwanirira. Kubanga bwe tuyitibwa okuwaayo obulamu bwaffe, kya bwetaavu ddala okumanya ku nsonga ki gye tunywerera. Obunywevu bwe twetaaga tetuyinza kubufuna, wabula nga bwesigamiziddwa ku bukakafu obw’okukkiriza. Kituufu nti waliyo abantu abayinza okulabika, abeeteeka mu kufa mu busirusiru olw’okunywerera ku ndowooza enkyamu n’ebirooto ebyeyongera mu mitwe gyabwe bo, naye obwangu obwenkanidde awo businga kuyitibwa ddalu okusinga okunyiikira kwa Bukristo; era mazima, tewali bunywevu wadde amagezi mu abo abeekasuka bwe batyo mu bufunze awatali kulowooza. Kyokka, ka kibe bwe kityo, mu nsonga ennungi yokka Katonda mw’ayinza okututegeerera nga abaffiira be. Okufa kufa kwa buli muntu, era abaana ba Katonda basalirwa omusango gw’ensonyi n’okubonyaabonyezebwa nga bwe kiri eri abamenyi b’amateeka; naye Katonda abaawula, kubanga tayinza kwegaana mazima ge. Ku lwaffe, kyetaagisa nti tubeere n’obukakafu obw’amazima era obutayinza kulimba obw’enjigiriza gye tunywerera; noolwekyo, nga bwe njogedde, tetuyinza kuwuubaala mu magezi olw’okubuulirira kwe tuweebwa okugumiikiriza okuyigganyizibwa olw’Enjiri, bwe wataba bukakafu bwa kukkiriza obwawandiikiddwa mu mitima gyaffe. Kubanga okuteeka obulamu bwaffe mu kabi awatali bukakafu si kya buzaaliranwa, era ne bwe tukikola, kyandibadde bungu bwokka, so si buvumu bwa Bukristo. Mu kigambo kimu, tewali kye tukola kirisiimibwa Katonda bwe tutaba bakakasibbwa ddala nti tuyigganyizibwa ku lulwe n’olw’ensonga ye, era ng’ensi y’omulabe waffe. Kaakano, bwe njogera ku bukakafu obwenkana awo, sitegeeza kwawula bwokka wakati w’eddiini ey’amazima n’obukyamu oba obusirusiru bw’abantu, naye era nti tuteekwa okukakasibwa ddala ku bulamu obw’omu ggulu, n’engule etusuubizibwa waggulu, oluvannyuma lw’okulwana wano wansi. Kale ka tutegeere nti ebyetaagisa byombi bya bwetaavu, era tebiyinza kwawukanyizibwa. Noolwekyo, ensonga gye tuteekwa okusookera kwe zino: Tuteekwa okumanya bulungi Obukristo bwaffe kye buli, okukkiriza kwe tuteekwa okukwata n’okugoberera kye kuli, n’etteeka Katonda ly’atuwadde kye liri; era tuteekwa okuba abagunjuddwa mu njigiriza eyo ne tusobola n’obuvumu okuvumirira obulimba, obukyamu, n’eddogo lyonna Setaani lye yaleeta okwonoona obutuukirivu obw’amazima obw’enjigiriza ya Katonda. Noolwekyo, tetusaana kwewuunya nti mu biro bino tulaba abantu batono ennyo abeetegese okubonaabonera Enjiri, era nti ekitundu ekisinga obungi ku abo abeeyita Abakristo tebamanyi kye kiri. Kubanga bonna, wamu nga bwe kiri, ba bunnyogovu; era mu kifo ky’okufuula ekyo omulimu gwabwe okuwuliriza oba okusoma, bamala okulowooza nti kimala okuba nga baakomba ku kukkiriza kwa Bukristo. Eyo y’ensonga lwaki waliyo obumalirivu obutono ennyo, era lwaki abo abalumbibwa amangu ago bagwa. Ekyo kitusaanira kutukubiriza kwekenneenya n’obunyiikivu obungi mu mazima ga Katonda, tulyoke tube abakakafu ddala ku gago. Naye kyokka, okumanya obulungi n’okuba omunywevu si bwe bwonna obwetaavu. Kubanga tulaba abamu abalabika ng’abajjudde ddala enjigiriza entuufu, naye ate nga tebalina kunyiikira wadde okwagala kusinga abo abatamanyanga ku Katonda okuggyako endowooza empewuke. Lwaki bwe kiri bwe kityo? Kubanga tebategeeranga bukulu bw’Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu. Era mazima, singa ffe, nga bwe tuli, tulowooza bulungi nti Katonda ye yatwogerako, tekirina kubuusabuusa nti twandiwulirizza n’obwegendereza n’ekitiibwa ekisingako. Singa tulowooza nti bwe tusoma Ebyawandiikibwa tuli mu ssomero ery’abamalayika, twandibadde n’obwegendereza n’okwegomba okusingako okuganyulwa mu njigiriza etuweebwa. Kaakano tulaba engeri entuufu ey’okwetegeka okubonaabonera Enjiri. Ekisooka, tuteekwa okuba nga twegendeddemu mu ssomero lya Katonda okutuusa lwe tumaliridde ku ddiini ey’amazima n’enjigiriza gye tuteekwa okunywerera; era tuteekwa okunyooma enkwe zonna n’obulimba bwa Setaani, n’ebyayiiya byonna eby’abantu, ng’ebintu ebitalimu makulu naye era eby’omubiri, kubanga byonoona obutuukirivu bwa Bukristo; nga bwe tutyo tuba twawukana, ng’abaffiira ba Kristo ab’amazima, ku bantu ab’endowooza empewuke ababonaabonera ebitalimu makulu. Ekyokubiri, nga tukakasibbwa ku nsonga ennungi, tuteekwa okwakira ddala olw’okugoberera Katonda buli gy’anaatuyita: Ekigambo kye kiteekwa okuba n’obuyinza obwenkana bwe kigwanira, era nga twekutudde ku nsi eno, tuteekwa okuwulira nga twekwaddwa mu kunoonya obulamu obw’omu ggulu. Naye kya kwewuunya ennyo nti, wadde ng’omusana gwa Katonda gwaka bulungi okusinga bwe gwali gwaka edda, waliyo obutanyiikira obunakuwaza! Bwe kiba nga ekyo tekitukwasa nsonyi, kale ekibi kyeyongera. Kubanga mu bbanga eritali ly’ewala tugenda kujja mu maaso g’Omulamuzi omukulu, obutali butuukirivu bwe twagezaako okukweka gye buliyanjululirwa n’okunenyezebwa okunene ne tuswala ddala. Kubanga, oba nga tuwalirizibwa okuwa obujulizi eri Katonda, ng’ekigero ky’okumanya kw’atuwadde bwe kiri, ndaba kiki ekituleetera okuba abannyogovu era abatya bwe tuyingira mu lutalo, nga tulaba nga Katonda yeeyolese bw’atyo mu kiseera kino nga bw’ayinza okuyogerwako nti atuggulidde n’atwanjululizza obugagga obunene obw’ebyama bye? Tekiyinza kwogerwa nti tetulowooza nti tulina omulimu ne Katonda? Kubanga singa twassaayo omwoyo ku bukulu bwe, tetwandigumiikirizza kukyusa njigiriza eva gy’ali okugifuula engeri ey’okulowoozaamu okw’amagezi ag’ensi. Mu bufunze, tekiyinza kwegaanibwa nti kya nsonyi nnene, si kya kutwogerako busalizo bwa ntiisa, nti twamanya bulungi bwe tutyo amazima ga Katonda, ate ne tuba n’obuvumu obutono bwe butyo okugawagira! Okusingira ddala byonna, bwe tutunuulira abaffiira ab’ebiro eby’edda, tusaana nnyo okukyawa obulyolyo bwaffe! Ekitundu ekisinga obungi ku abo tebaali bantu bamanyi nnyo Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu, ne basobola okuwakana ku nsonga zonna. Baamanya nti waliyo Katonda omu, gwe baateekwa okusinza n’okuweereza—nti baali banunulibbwa n’omusaayi gwa Yesu Kristo, balyoke bateeke obwesige bwabwe obw’obulokozi mu Ye ne mu kisa kye—era nti, ebyayiiya byonna eby’abantu nga bya bwerere era bya kasasiro, baali basaana okuvumirira okusinza ebifaananyi n’eddogo lyonna. Mu kigambo kimu, enjigiriza yaabwe mu bukulu yali bwe ti—Waliyo Katonda omu eyatonda ensi yonna, n’atulaga by’ayagala okuyita mu Musa ne bannabbi, era n’ekisembayo okuyita mu Yesu Kristo n’abatume be; era tulina Omununuzi omu yekka, eyatugula n’omusaayi gwe, era olw’ekisa kye gye tusuubira okulokolebwa: Ebifaananyi byonna eby’ensi bikolimiddwa, era bisaana okukyayibwa. Nga balina enkola etaliimu nsonga ndala okuggyako zino, baagenda n’obuvumu mu muliro, oba mu ngeri endala yonna ey’okufa. Tebaagenda babiri babiri oba basatu basatu, naye mu bibinja ebinene, olwo omuwendo gw’abo abaagwa mu mikono gy’abafuzi ab’obukambwe nga tegukoma! Ffe, ku lwaffe, tuli bayigirize bagezigezi nga tewali asinga (bwe tutyo bwe tulowooza), era mazima, ku bikwata ku kumanya Ebyawandiikibwa, Katonda abitwanjululidde bwe kityo nga tewali mulembe gwabaddewo ogwaganyulwa bwe kityo. Wabula, oluvannyuma lwa byonna, tewali n’akatono k’obunyiikivu. Abantu bwe boolesa obutafaayo obwenkanidde awo, kirabika ng’abasunguwaza okuwoolerezebwa kwa Katonda. Kale kiki ekyandikoleddwa okwongera obuvumu obw’amazima mu mitima gyaffe? Ekisooka, tulina okulowooza engeri okwatula okukkiriza kwaffe bwe kuli okw’omuwendo mu maaso ga Katonda. Tetumanyi bulungi engeri Katonda gy’akussaamu omuwendo, obanga obulamu bwaffe, obutali kantu, tubussaamu omuwendo omungi okusinga. Bwe kiba bwe kityo, twoleka obusirusiru obw’ekitalo. Tetuyinza kununula bulamu bwaffe nga tuwaayo okwatula kwaffe awatali kukkiriza nti tubussaamu omuwendo omungi okusinga ekitiibwa kya Katonda n’obulokozi bw’emyoyo gyaffe. Omukafiiri yasobola okugamba nti "Kyali kya nnaku okununula obulamu ng’oleka ebintu byokka ebyaleeta obulamu okuba obw’okwegomba!" Naye kyokka ye n’abalala abaali nga ye tebaamanyanga nsonga ki abantu gye bateekerwa mu nsi, era lwaki babeeramu. Kituufu baamanya bimala okugamba nti abantu basaana okugoberera obulungi, okweyisa mu bwesimbu awatali kunenyezebwa; naye obulungi bwabwe bwonna bwali langi na mukka bwokka. Ffe tumanyi obulungi ekigendererwa ekikulu eky’obulamu kye kiri, kwe kugulumiza Katonda, alyoke abe ekitiibwa kyaffe. Bwe kitakolebwa bwe kityo, zitusanze! Era tetuyinza kweyongera kubeera balamu kaseera na kamu ku nsi awatali kwongera bikolimo ku mitwe gyaffe. Naye kyokka tetukwatibwa nsonyi kugula nnaku ntono okulwana wano wansi, nga twegaana obwakabaka obutaggwaawo olw’okwawukana ku Oyo gwe tuwanirirwa amaanyi mu bulamu. Singa twabuuza abantu abasingira ddala obutamanya, si kwogera ku basinga obusirusiru mu nsi, lwaki babeera balamu, tebandiyanenye kuddamu kigambo nti kwe kulya, n’okunywa, n’okwebaka; kubanga bonna bamanyi nti baatondebwa olw’ekigendererwa ekiwaggulu era ekitukuvu. Kale kigendererwa ki kye tuyinza okuzuula okuggyako okuwa Katonda ekitiibwa, n’okwekkiriza okufugibwa Ye, ng’abaana bwe bafugibwa abazadde abalungi; olwo bwe tumala olugendo lw’obulamu buno obuvunda, tulyoke tuyingizibwe mu busika bwe obutaggwaawo? Ekyo kye kigendererwa ekikulu, weewaawo eky’obwomu. Bwe tutakissaako mwoyo, ne tumalirira ku bulamu obw’ensolo, obusinga okufa okw’emirundi olukumi obubi, kiki kye tuyinza okuwoza olw’okwewolereza kwaffe? Okuba omulamu awatali kumanya nsonga ki tekiri kya buzaaliranwa. Okugaana ensonga ze tubeerera abalamu, olw’okwegomba okusiruvu okuwummulako nnaku ntono, ze tugenda okumala mu nsi, nga twawukanye ku Katonda—simanyi ngeri ya kuyita busiru na ddalu bwe butyo! Naye kubanga okuyigganyizibwa bulijjo kukalubo era kukaawa, ka tulowooze engeri n’obukodyo Abakristo gye bayinza okwenywezaamu n’okugumiikiriza, ne bawaayo obulamu bwabwe awatali kutya olw’amazima ga Katonda. Ekyawandiikibwa kye tusomye, bwe kitegeerekeka bulungi, kimala okutukubiriza okukola bwe tutyo. Omutume agamba nti, Kale naffe tufulume tulage gy’ali ebweru w’olusiisira nga twetisse ekivume kye. Ekisooka, atujjukiza nti, ne bwe ebitala byandibadde tebisowoddwa ku ffe wadde omuliro okukoleezebwa okutwokya, tetuyinza kwegatta ddala ku Mwana wa Katonda nga tukyasibiddwa mu nsi eno. Noolwekyo Omukristo, ne bw’aba mu kuwummula, bulijjo ateekwa okuba n’ekigere kimu nga akiyimusizza okutambula okugenda mu lutalo, so si ekyo kyokka, naye ateekwa okuba n’okwagala kwe nga kuggiddwa ku nsi, wadde omubiri gwe nga gukyabeera mu yo. Ka kibe nti mu kusooka kitulabika nga kikalubo, naye tuteekwa okumatizibwa ebigambo bya Pawulo (1 Basessaloniika 3), nti twayitibwa era ne tulondebwa okubonaabona. Nga ne bw’agambye nti, Bwe kutyo bwe kuli okubeera kwaffe ng’Abakristo; luno lwe lugendo lwe tuteekwa okuyitamu bwe twagala okugoberera Kristo. Mu kiseera kye kimu, okusanyusa obunafu bwaffe n’okukendeeza ku kubonaabona n’ennaku okuyigganyizibwa kwe kuyinza okutuleetera, empeera ennungi eweereddwayo: Bwe tubonaabonera ensonga ya Katonda, tutambula kigere ku kigere nga tugoberera Omwana wa Katonda, era nga tumulina ng’omukulembeze waffe. Singa kyagambiddwa bwokka nti okuba Abakristo tuteekwa okuyita mu kuvvoolebwa kwonna okw’ensi n’obuvumu, okusisinkana okufa buli kiseera ne mu ngeri yonna Katonda gy’anaasiima, twandiyinzizza okuba n’ekigambo eky’okuddamu nti lugendo lwa kitalo okugenda mu busalizo. Naye bwe tulagirwa okugoberera Mukama Yesu, obukulembeze bwe bulungi era bwa kitiibwa nnyo okuba obw’okugaanibwa. Kaakano, tulyoke tunyeenyezebwe okusingako, si kyokka nti kigambibwa nti Yesu Kristo atukulembera ng’Omuduumizi waffe, naye era nti tufuulibwa okufaanana ekifaananyi kye; bw’atyo Pawulo bw’agamba mu ssuula ey’omunaana ey’Abaruumi nti Katonda yalagira abo bonna b’ayaza okuba abaana be okufuulibwa okufaanana Oyo ali kyokulabirako era omutwe gwa bonna. Tuli abanafu bwe tutyo okutaagala kugumiikiriza kantu? Kale tuteekwa okwegaana ekisa kya Katonda kye yatuyitiramu eri essuubi ery’obulokozi. Kubanga waliyo ebintu bibiri ebitayinza kwawukanyizibwa—okuba ebitundu bya Kristo, n’okugezesebwa mu kubonaabona okungi. Mazima tusaana okussa omuwendo ku kufaanana Omwana wa Katonda okusinga bwe tukikola. Kituufu nti mu kusala omusango kw’ensi mulimu ensonyi mu kubonaabonera Enjiri. Naye kubanga tumanyi nti abakkiriza bazibe b’amaaso, tetusaana kuba n’amaaso amalungi okusinga bo? Kya nsonyi okubonaabonera abo abatudde ku ntebe ey’obwenkanya, naye Pawulo atulaga mu kyokulabirako kye nti tulina okwenyumiririza mu mbooko olwa Yesu Kristo, ng’obubonero Katonda bw’atumanyiramu era bw’atwatuliramu okuba ababe. Era tumanyi Lukka ky’ayogera ku Peetero ne Yokaana (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 5:41); nti baasanyuka olw’okubalibwa nga basaanira okubonaabona n’okuvumibwa olw’erinnya lya Mukama Yesu. Ensonyi n’ekitiibwa bintu bibiri eby’enjawulo: bwe kityo ensi bw’eyogera, eyo, olw’okuba nga ya basiru, esala omusango ewakanya amagezi gonna, era mu ngeri eno ekyusa ekitiibwa kya Katonda okukifuula obuswavu. Naye ku lwaffe, tuleme okugaana okuvumibwa ku by’ensi, tulyoke tuweebwe ekitiibwa mu maaso ga Katonda ne bamalayika be. Tulaba obuzibu abaagala ebitiibwa bwe beeteesaako okufuna ebiragiro bya kabaka, n’engeri gye beenyumirizaamu. Omwana wa Katonda atuwa ebiragiro bye, naye buli omu adda ennyuma. Mbuuza, mulabe, obanga mu kukola bwe kityo tusaanira okuba n’ekintu kyonna ekifaanagana naye? Tewali kintu wano kisikiriza obuntu bwaffe obw’omubiri, naye kyokka ebyo bye bubonero bw’ekitiibwa obw’amazima obw’omu ggulu. Okusibibwa mu kkomera, obuwaŋŋanguse, okwogerwako obubi, mu ndowooza y’abantu bireeta ekyo kyonna ekivumibwa; naye kiki ekitulemesa okutunuulira ebintu nga Katonda bw’abisala era bw’abyogerako, okuggyako obutakkiriza bwaffe? Noolwekyo, ka erinnya ly’Omwana wa Katonda libe n’obuzito bwonna bwe ligwanira gye tuli, tulyoke tuyige okukibala ekitiibwa bw’atateeka obubonero bwe ku ffe. Bwe tukola bulala obutasiima bwaffe tebugumiikirizika. Singa Katonda yatuyisa ng’okusaana kwaffe bwe kuli, tekyandibadde n’ensonga entuufu ey’okutukangavvula buli lunaku mu ngeri lukumi? Weewaawo n’okusingawo, okufa emitwalo kikumi tekyandimazeeko kitundu kitono eky’ebibi byaffe! Kaakano, bw’aba mu bulungi bwe obutaggwaawo ateeka ebibi byaffe byonna wansi w’ekigere kye n’abizikiriza, era mu kifo ky’okutubonereza ng’obubi bwaffe bwe buli, ayiiya engeri ey’ekitalo okukyusa okubonaabona kwaffe okukufuula ekitiibwa n’enkizo ey’enjawulo, kubanga okuyita mu kwo tuyingizibwa mu kussekimu n’Omwana we, tekyandiyogerwa, bwe tunyooma embeera ennungi bwe etyo, nti mazima twakulaakulana katono nnyo mu njigiriza ya Bukristo? Noolwekyo, Peetero, bwe yamala okutukubiriza (1 Peetero 4:15) okutambula mu butuukirivu mu kutya Katonda, tuleme kubonaabona ng’ababbi, abenzi, n’abatemu, amangu ago ayongerako nti, bwe tuba tuteekwa okubonaabona ng’Abakristo, ka tugulumize Katonda olw’omukisa gw’atuwa bwe gutyo. Si kya bwereere ky’ayogera bw’atyo. Kubanga ffe ba ani, mbuuza, okuba abajulizi b’amazima ga Katonda, n’abawagizi okulwanirira ensonga ye? Wano tuli nvunyu enkole ez’ensi, ebitonde ebijjudde obutaliimu, ebijjudde obulimba, naye kyokka Katonda atukozesa okulwanirira amazima ge—ekitiibwa ekitatuuka na ku bamalayika ab’omu ggulu! Okulowooza kuno kwokka tekwandituleeteredde okwakira okwewaayo eri Katonda okukozesebwa mu ngeri yonna mu buweereza obw’ekitiibwa bwe butyo? Wabula abantu bangi tebayinza kwerema kuwakanya Katonda, oba, okuli okwemulugunya gy’ali olw’obutawagira bulungi obunafu bwabwe. Kya kwewuunya nnyo, bwe bagamba, engeri Katonda, ng’amaze okutulonda okuba abaana be, gy’atuleka okulinnyirirwa n’okubonyaabonyezebwa aboonoonyi. Nziramu nti: Ne bwe kitandirabise lwaki akola bw’atyo, yandisobodde okukozesa obuyinza bwe ku ffe, n’assaawo omugabo gwaffe nga bwe yeeyagala. Naye bwe tulaba nti Yesu Kristo ye kyokulabirako kyaffe, tetusaanira, awatali kwongera kubuuza, okukibala kya ssanyu kinene okufuulibwa okufaanana Ye? Katonda, kyokka, akikakasa bulungi ensonga lwaki asiima ffe okuyigganyizibwa. Singa tetwabadde na kirala okuggyako ekyo Peetero kye yategeeza (1 Peetero 1:7), twandibadde banyoomi ddala okutakikkiriza. Agamba nti, kubanga zaabu ne ffeeza, ebiri ebyuma ebivunda bwokka, bitukuzibwa ne bigezesebwa mu muliro, kya bwenkanya nti okukkiriza kwaffe, okusinga obugagga bwonna obw’ensi, kugezesebwe bwe kityo. Kyandibadde kyangu ddala eri Katonda okututtikira engule mu kaseera awatali kutwetaagisa kulwana ntalo zonna; naye nga bwe kiri okusiima kwe nti okutuusa ku nkomerero y’ensi Kristo afugire wakati mu balabe be, bwe kityo era kwe kusiima kwe nti ffe, nga tuteekeddwa wakati waabwe, tugumiikirize okunyigirizibwa n’obukambwe bwabwe okutuusa lw’anaatununula. Mmanyi, mazima, nti omubiri gujeema bwe guleeterwa ku nsonga eno, naye kyokka okwagala kwa Katonda kuteekwa okuwangula. Bwe tuwulira okuziyira mu ffe, tekitwewuunyisa; kubanga kya buzaaliranwa gye tuli okwewala omusaalaba. Naye kyokka tuleme kulemererwa kugusukkuluma, nga tumanyi nti Katonda akkiriza obuwulize bwaffe, obanga tuleeta enneewulira n’okwegomba kwaffe kwonna mu buwambe ne tubifuula eby’okugonda gy’ali. Bannabbi n’abatume bwe baagenda mu kufa, tekyali awatali kuwulira akayagalira ak’okuziyira. "omuntu omulala n’akusiba n’akutwala gy’otoyagala." Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo bwe yagamba Peetero. (Yokaana 21:18.) Okutya okw’okufa bwe kuvaayo mu ffe, ka tukuwangule, oba okusinga awo ka Katonda akuwangule; ate mu kiseera kye kimu, ka tukakase nti tumuwa ssaddaaka esanyusa bwe tuziyiza ne tunyiga enneegombera zaffe olw’okwewaayo ddala mu buyinza bwe: Guno gwe lutalo olusinga Katonda lw’ayagala abantu be okwenyigiramu. Ayagala okubalwanyisa okumalawo buli ndowooza n’enneewulira eyeejeemu eyandibaggya ku kkubo ly’abalaga. Era essanyu weeriri lingi nnyo n’okuyinza kigambibwe nti, tuli bati ate n’okusingawo bwe tuggwaamu amaanyi! Mu biro eby’edda abantu bangi ennyo, okufuna engule ennyangu ey’amakoola, tebaagaana kutegana, kubonaabona, wadde kuzibuwalirwa; weewaawo n’okufa tekyabakaluubirira, ate nga buli omu ku bo yalwanira mu busalizo, nga tamanyi oba agenda kuwangula oba okufiirwa empeera. Katonda atuwa engule etaggwaawo, gye tuyinza okuyita ne tugabana ekitiibwa kye: Tayagala tulwanire mu busalizo, naye ffenna tulina okusuubizibwa empeera gye tulwanira. Kale tulina ensonga ki ey’okugaana okulwana? Tulowooza nti kyayogerwa bwereere nti bwe tufiira wamu ne Yesu Kristo era tulibeera balamu wamu naye? Okuwangula kwaffe kutegekeddwa, ate nga tukola byonna bye tuyinza okwewala olutalo. Naye kigambibwa nti byonna bye tuyigiriza ku nsonga eno biwakanya okusala kw’abantu. Nkiryaanya. Era noolwekyo Omulokozi waffe bw’alangirira nti, "Balina omukisa abayigganyizibwa olw’obutuukirivu" (Matayo 5:10), awa endowooza etakkirizibwa mangu mu nsi. Wabula, ayagala okubala ekyo ng’essanyu, ekiri mu kusala kw’amagezi ag’omubiri nga bunaku. Twerabira nga tuli banaku Katonda bw’atuleka okulinnyirirwa obufuzi obukambwe n’obukyayi bw’abalabe baffe; naye ensobi eri nti tetutunuulira bisuubizo bya Katonda, ebitukakasa nti byonna birifuuka okulungi kwaffe. Tuggwaamu amaanyi bwe tulaba ababi nga batusinga amaanyi, era nga bateeka ekigere kyabwe ku mumiro gwaffe; naye okutabukatabuka okwo kusaana, nga Pawulo bw’agamba, kutuleetere okuyimusa emitwe gyaffe. Kubanga tuli abeetegefu okumalako ebiseera mu bintu ebiriwo kaakano, Katonda mu kukkiriza ababi okufuga, n’abalungi okubonyaabonyezebwa, alaga n’obubonero obulabika nti waliyo olunaku olujja lwe byonna ebiri mu kutabukatabuka kaakano birituusibwa mu ntegeka. Bwe kitulabika ekiseera nga kya wala, ka tudduke eri eddagala, so si okwewaanawaana mu kibi kyaffe; kubanga kya lwatu nti tetulina kukkiriza bwe tutasobola kutunuula mu maaso okutuuka ku kujja kwa Yesu Kristo. Okuleka awatali kukozesa buli kintu ekiyinza okutunyiiza, Katonda atuteekera mu maaso ebisuubizo ku ludda olumu n’entiisa ku ludda olulala. Bwe tuwulira nti ebisuubizo tebirina buyinza bumala, ka tubinyweze nga tubyongerako entiisa. Kituufu tuteekwa okuba abakyamu ennyo obutassa bwesige mungi mu bisuubizo bya Katonda, Mukama Yesu bw’agamba nti alitwatulira mu maaso ga Kitaawe, obanga tumwatulira mu maaso g’abantu. (Matayo 10:32; Lukka 12:8.) Kiki ekyanditulemesezza okwatula kw’atwetaagisa? Ka abantu bakole kye basobola okusingayo, tebayinza kukola kubi kusinga kututta! Ate obulamu obw’omu ggulu tebuligyawo kino? Wano sikuŋŋaanya byonna ebiwandiiko ebiri mu Byawandiikibwa ebikwata ku nsonga eno: biddirwamu emirundi mingi ne kitusaanira okumatizibwa nabyo ddala. Olutalo bwe lujja, oba ebiwandiiko bisatu oba bina bwe bitakumala, ekikumi kizanya kitusaana okutufuula abanywevu eri okukemebwa kwonna okuwakana. Naye oba nga Katonda tayinza kutusika gy’ali mu ngeri ennungi, tetuba nga mabaati bwe n’entiisa ye bw’egaana okutukwatako? Yesu Kristo ayita abo bonna abanaaba beegaanye amazima olw’okutya okufa okw’ekiseera okujja mu maaso ga Katonda Kitaawe, era agamba nti olwo omubiri n’omwoyo biriweebwayo mu kuzikirira. (Matayo 10:28; Lukka 12:5.) Ate mu kifo ekirala agamba nti alyegaana abo bonna abanaaba beemulugunyizza okumwegaana mu maaso g’abantu. (Matayo 10:33; Lukka 12:10.) Ebigambo bino, bwe tutaba nga tetuwulira ddala, byandisobodde okuyimusa enviiri zaffe. Ka kibe bwe kityo, ekyo kikakafu; ebintu bino bwe bitatunyeenya nga bwe kigwanidde, tewali kitusigaddeyo okuggyako omusango ogw’entiisa. (Abaebbulaniya 10:27.) Ebigambo bya Kristo byonna bwe biba nga tebigasa, tusigala nga tukakasibbwa obutakkiriza obw’amaanyi. Kya bwereere okuwoza nti tusaana okulaga ekisa, kubanga obuntu bwaffe bunafu nnyo; kubanga kigambibwa, mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, nti Musa, bwe yatunuulira Katonda olw’okukkiriza, yanywezebwa n’atagonda ku kukemebwa kwonna. Noolwekyo, bwe tuba abagonvu era ab’okugonda amangu, kabonero ka lwatu, sigamba nti tetulina bunyiikivu, wadde obunywevu, wabula nti tetumanyi kimu ku Katonda wadde obwakabaka bwe. Bwe tujjukizibwa nti tusaana okwegatta ku Mutwe gwaffe, kitulabika ng’ekyokwewolereza ekirungi okugamba nti tuli bantu. Naye baali baani abo abaakulembera mu kkubo? Mazima, singa tetwabadde na kirala okuggyako enjigiriza entuukirivu, ebyokwewolereza byaffe byonna byandibadde bya bwereere; naye nga tulina ebyokulabirako bingi bwe bityo ebyandituwadde obukakafu obusinga amaanyi, tusingirawo okusalirwa omusango. Waliyo ensonga bbiri ez’okulowoozebwako. Ensooka eri nti, omubiri gwonna ogw’Ekkanisa awamu bulijjo gubaddewo, era okutuusa ku nkomerero gulibaawo, nga guyinza okubonyaabonyezebwa aboonoonyi, nga bwe kigambibwa mu Zabbuli (Zabbuli 129:1), "Bambonyaabonyezza nnyo okuva mu buvubuka bwange, ne bayisa ekyuma ekirima ku mugongo gwange okuva ku ludda olumu okutuuka ku lulala." Omwoyo Omutukuvu awo aleeta Ekkanisa eya edda, tulyoke, nga tumaze okumanya bulungi okubonaabona kwayo, tuleme okukibala nga kipya oba ekitunyiiza bwe kituukibwa ku ffe mu biro bino. Pawulo, era, ng’ajuliza mu Zabbuli endala (Abaruumi 8:36; Zabbuli 44:22), ekigambo ekigamba nti, "tubalibwa ng’endiga ez’okusalibwa," alaga nti ekyo tekyabaawo mu mulembe gumu gwokka, naye kwe kubeera kwa buli kiseera okw’Ekkanisa, era bwe kiribeera. Noolwekyo, bwe tulaba engeri Ekkanisa ya Katonda gy’erinnyirirwa mu biro bino ab’ensi ab’amalala, engeri omu gy’aboggolera n’omulala okuluma, engeri gye babonyaabonya, gye bagisalira enkwe, gye erumbibwa obutakoma embwa ez’eddalu n’ensolo enkambwe, ka kitujjukize nti ekintu kye kimu kyakolebwa mu biro byonna eby’edda. Kituufu Katonda oluusi agiwa akaseera k’okuwummulako, era noolwekyo mu Zabbuli eyogeddwako waggulu kigambibwa nti, "amenyeemenye enjegere z’abakola ebibi," ne mu kifo ekirala (Zabbuli 125:3), "Kubanga abafuzi abakola ebibi tebalifugira mu nsi y’abatuukirivu, baleme okuwaliriza abatuukirivu okukola ebibi." Naye kyokka kimusanyusizza nti Ekkanisa ye bulijjo ebeere n’okulwana ng’ekyali mu nsi eno, okuwummula kwayo nga kuterekeddwa waggulu mu ggulu. (Abaebbulaniya 3:9.) Mu kiseera kye kimu, enkomerero y’okubonaabona kwayo bulijjo ebadde nnungi. Mu byonna, Katonda akoze nti wadde ng’enyigirizibbwa emitawaana mingi, tereeyerwaako ddala; nga bwe kigambibwa (Zabbuli 7:15), "Asima ekinnya, n’akiwanvuya nnyo; ate n’akigwamu ye kye yasimye." Pawulo yeenyumiririza mu kino, era alaga nti luno lwe lugendo Katonda mu kusaasira lw’akwata bulijjo. Agamba (1 Abakkolinso 4:12) nti tugumiikiriza ennaku, naye tetunyigirizibwa ddala; tufuuka abaavu, naye tetulekebwa awatali kantu; tuyigganyizibwa, naye tetulekebwa; tusuulibwa wansi, naye tetuzikirira; nga twetisse buli wamu mu mibiri gyaffe okufa kwa Mukama Yesu, obulamu bwe bulyoke bulabisibwe mu mibiri gyaffe egifa. Nga bwe kityo bwe kuli, nga bwe tulaba, enkomerero Katonda gy’awadde buli kiseera okuyigganyizibwa kw’Ekkanisa ye, tusaana okwakira, nga tumanyi nti bajjajjaffe, abaali bantu abanafu nga ffe, bulijjo baawangula abalabe baabwe olw’okusigala nga banywevu mu kugumiikiriza. Nkoma kutuukirira ku nsonga eno mu bufunze ndyoke ntuuke ku nsonga ey’okubiri, esinga okukwata ku kigendererwa kyaffe, kwe kuti, tusaana okuganyulwa mu byokulabirako eby’enjawulo eby’abaffiira abaatukulembera. Bino tebikoma ku babiri oba basatu, naye biri, ng’omutume bw’agamba (Abaebbulaniya 12:1), "ekibiina ekinene eky’abajulirwa ekyenkana awo." Mu bigambo bino ategeeza nti omuwendo munene nnyo ne gusaana, wamu nga bwe kiri, okutwaliira ddala amaaso gaffe gonna. Nneme okukooya, nzija kwogera ku Bayudaaya bokka, abaayigganyizibwa olw’eddiini ey’amazima, nga bwe kityo wansi w’obufuzi obukambwe obwa Kabaka Antiyokusi, ne katono oluvannyuma lw’okufa kwe. Tetuyinza kuwoza nti omuwendo gw’ababonaabona gwali mutono, kubanga gwakola, wamu nga bwe kiri, eggye ery’abaffiira. Tetuyinza kugamba nti gwakomawo ku bannabbi Katonda be yali ayawudde ku bantu abaabulijjo, kubanga abakazi n’abaana abato baali kitundu ky’ekibinja. Tetuyinza kugamba nti baawona ku muwendo mutono, kubanga baabonyaabonyezebwa n’obukambwe nga bwe kyasoboka. Noolwekyo, tuwulira omutume ky’agamba (Abaebbulaniya 11:35), nti abamu baagololebwa ng’engoma, nga tebafaayo kununulibwa, balyoke bafune okuzuukira okusingako obulungi; abalala baagezesebwa n’okuduula n’okukubibwa, oba ebisiba n’amakomera; abalala baakubibwa amayinja oba baasalibwa n’emisumeeno; abalala baatambula waggulu ne wansi, nga bawulukuka mu nsozi ne mu mpuku. Ka kaakano tugeraageranye embeera yaabwe n’eyaffe. Oba baagumiikiriza bwe batyo olw’amazima agaali edda nga tegannaba kutegeerekeka bulungi, kiki kye tusaana okukola mu musana ogwaka kaakano? Katonda ayogera naffe n’akamwa akaggule; oluggi olunene olw’obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu lugguddwawo, era Yesu Kristo atuyita gy’ali, ng’amaze okuserengeta gye tuli tulyoke tumufune, wamu nga bwe kiri, ng’ali mu maaso gaffe. Kya nsonyi ki gye tuli okuba n’obunyiikivu obutono mu kubonaabonera Enjiri okusinga abo abaali balabidde ebisuubizo wala bwokka—abaali bagguliddwawo akaggi akatono okuyita mu ko okutuuka ku bwakabaka bwa Katonda, era abaalina ekijjukizo n’ekyokulabirako kya Yesu Kristo kyokka? Ebintu bino tebiyinza kwogerwa mu kigambo kimu, nga bwe bisaanira, era noolwekyo nleka buli omu okubirowoozaako yekka. Enjigiriza eyanjuddwa kaakano, olw’okuba nga ya bulijjo, esaana okukolebwako Abakristo bonna, nga buli omu agirambika mu bulamu bwe nga bwe kyetaagisa. Kino nkyogera, abo abatalaba nga bali mu kabi akalabika balyoke baleme okukibala ng’ekitagasa gye bali. Kaakano tebali mu mikono gy’abafuzi ab’obukambwe, naye bamanyi batya Katonda ky’agenda okubakolako mu maaso? Noolwekyo tusaana okuba abeetegefu bwe tutyo nti bwe kunajja okuyigganyizibwa kwe tutaali tusuubidde, tuleme okukwatibwa nga tetweteeseteese. Naye ntya nnyo nti waliyo amatu amangi amaggavu ku nsonga eno. Abo abali mu bukuumi ne mu mirembe bali wala bwe batyo ku kwetegeka okufa nga kyetaagisa, ne batafaayo n’okuweereza Katonda mu bulamu bwabwe. Naye kyokka kisigala nga kya mazima nti okwetegeka kuno okw’okuyigganyizibwa kusaana okuba omulimu gwaffe ogwa bulijjo, na ddala mu biseera bino bye tubeeramu. Ate abo Katonda b’ayita okubonaabonera obujulizi bw’erinnya lye basaana okulaga mu bikolwa nti baatendekebwa ddala mu kugumiikiriza. Olwo basaana okujjukira okubuulirira kwonna kwe baaweebwa mu biro eby’edda, ne beenyeenya nga bwe kityo omuserikale bw’afubutuka eri ebyokulwanyisa ng’omuyaga gukoona. Naye enkomerero ya njawulo nnyo. Ekibuuzo kyokka kwe kuzuula obukodyo bw’okwewala. Kino nkyogera ku kitundu ekisinga obungi; kubanga okuyigganyizibwa kwe kugezesa okw’amazima Katonda kw’akozesa okumanya abaabe. Era abasajja abesigwa ku beetegese okusisinkana okufa n’obuvumu batono nnyo. Kya kitalo kya ntiisa, nti abantu abeenyumiririza mu kuba n’akatono k’Enjiri bayinza okwasama emimwa gyabwe ne boogera ebigambo ebiwakanya bwe bityo. Abamu baligamba nti, Tuganyulwa ki mu kwatula okukkiriza kwaffe eri abantu abakakanyavu abamaze okusalawo okulwanyisa Katonda? Kino si kusuula bugagga mu maaso g’embizzi? Nga Yesu Kristo teyalangirira lwatu (Makko 8:38) nti ayagala okwatulwa wakati mu babi n’ababi ennyo. Bo bwe batayigirizibwa, wamu nga bwe kiri, balisigala nga baswazizza; era noolwekyo okwatula kwa kaloosa akawooma mu maaso ga Katonda, ne bwe kuba nga kutta eri abaawakanyibwa. Waliyo abamu abagamba nti, Okufa kwaffe kunaaganyula ki? Tekulisooka kufuuka nkonge? Nga Katonda yabaleka okulonda okufa lwe banaakiraba nga kirungi ne bafuna ekiseera ekisaanidde. Wabula ffe, tukakasa obuwulize bwaffe nga tuleka mu mukono gwe amagoba agagenda okuva mu kufa kwaffe. Ekisooka, kale, omuntu Omukristo, buli gy’anaabeera, ateekwa okusalawo, wadde ng’awo waliwo obulabe oba entiisa, okutambula mu bwesimbu nga Katonda bw’alagidde. Ka yeekuume nga bw’asobola okuva mu kuluma kw’emisege, naye tekiba na bukujjukujju bw’omubiri. Okusingira ddala byonna, ka ateeke obulamu bwe mu mikono gya Katonda. Akikoze? Kale bw’agwa mu mikono gy’abalabe, ka alowooze nti Katonda, olw’okuteekateeka bw’atyo, asiimye okumufuula omu ku bajulirwa b’Omwana we, era noolwekyo talina ngeri ya kudda nnyuma awatali kumenya bwesigwa eri Oyo gwe twasuubiza obuwulize bwonna mu bulamu ne mu kufa—Oyo gwe tuli ababe era be tuli, wadde nga tetwakola ndagaano yonna. Nga njogera kino, sisuula bonna wansi w’obwetaavu obw’okwatula ddala buli kimu kye bakkiriza, wadde nga bandiwalirizibwa okukola bwe batyo. Mmanyi era ekigero Pawulo kye yakwata, wadde nga tewaali muntu eyali amaliridde okusingawo okulwanirira ensonga y’Enjiri nga bw’asaana. Era noolwekyo si kya bwereere Mukama waffe bw’atusuubiza okutuwa, ku mukisa ng’ogwo, "ebigambo n’amagezi" (Lukka 21:15); nga ne bw’agambye nti, omulimu gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu si kutunyweza bwokka okuba abavumu era ab’amaanyi, naye era n’okutuwa amagezi n’okwawula, okutuluŋŋamya mu kkubo eryandigasa okukwata. Ensonga ennene ey’ekyo kyonna eri nti, abo abali mu nnaku ng’eyo basaana okusaba ne bafuna amagezi ng’ago okuva waggulu, nga tebagoberera magezi gaabwe ag’omubiri, mu kunoonya ekituli kye banaayitamu okuwona. Waliyo abamu abatugamba nti Mukama waffe yennyini teyaddamu abo abaamubuuza. Naye nziramu, Ekisooka, nti kino tekiggyawo tteeka lye yatuwa okwatula okukkiriza kwaffe bwe tunaawalirizibwa. (1 Peetero 3:15.) Ekyokubiri, nti teyakozesa buwaŋŋanguse bwonna okuwonya obulamu bwe: era, Ekyokusatu, nti teyaddamu kuddamu kwabuusabuusa bwe kityo obutakwatamu bujulizi bumala ku byonna bye yalina okwogera; era, okugatta ku ekyo, yali amaze okumatiza abo abajja okumubuuza omulundi omulala, si kufuna bumanyirivu, naye okumutega emitego okumukwata. Ka kinywezebwe, kale, ng’ensonga enkakafu mu Bakristo bonna, nti tebasaana kussa mu bulamu bwabwe omuwendo omungi okusinga obujulizi obw’amazima, kubanga Katonda ayagala okugulumizibwa mu bwo. Kya bwereere okuba nga awa erinnya ery’abajulirwa (kubanga kino kye kitegeeza ekigambo omuffiira) eri abo bonna abalina okuddamu mu maaso g’abalabe b’okukkiriza? Si kubanga yayagala okubakozesa olw’ekigendererwa ng’ekyo? Wano buli omu tasaana kunoonya munne, kubanga Katonda tawa kitiibwa bonna mu ngeri y’emu ku kuyita. Era nga bwe tuli abeetegefu okutunula bwe tutyo, tuteekwa okwegendereza okusingawo. Peetero, bwe yamala okuwulira ku mimwa gya Mukama waffe Yesu (Yokaana 21:18) nti alikulemberwa mu bukadde bwe gy’atayagala, yabuuza, Munne Yokaana kirimutuukako ki? Tewali n’omu ku ffe atandyanguyiriza kubuuza kibuuzo kye kimu; kubanga endowooza evaayo mangu mu mutwe gwaffe eri, Lwaki nze mbonaabona okusinga abalala? Wabula, Yesu Kristo akubiriza ffenna awamu, era buli omu ku ffe mu bwe bwannannyini, okwesiba "abeetegefu," olwo nga bw’anaayita ono oba ono, tulyoke tufulume mu mulundi gwaffe. Nnyonnyodde waggulu engeri gye tutaabe beetegese okubonaabonera obuffiira, bwe tutaba twambadde ebisuubizo bya Katonda. Kaakano kisigadde okulaga obulungi obungi ekigendererwa n’ekiruubirirwa eby’ebisuubizo bino—si kubyogera byonna kinnakimu, naye okulaga ebintu ebikulu Katonda by’ayagala tusuubire okuva gy’ali, okutubudaabuda mu kubonaabona kwaffe. Kaakano ebintu bino, mu bufunze, bisatu. Ekisooka kiri nti, olw’okuba nga obulamu bwaffe n’okufa kwaffe biri mu mukono gwe, alitukuuma n’amaanyi ge nti tewali luviiri na lumu lulikuulibwa ku mitwe gyaffe awatali kukkiriza kwe. Noolwekyo abakkiriza basaana okukakasibwa nti buli mikono gye banaagwamu, Katonda taggyibwako bukuumi bw’akola ku bantu baabwe. Singa okukakasa okwo kwawandiikibwa bulungi mu mitima gyaffe, twandinunuddwa ku kitundu ekisinga obungi eky’okubuusabuusa n’okweraliikirira okututawaanya n’okutuziyiza mu buvunaanyizibwa bwaffe. Tulaba abafuzi ab’obukambwe nga basumuluddwa: awo kitulabika nga Katonda takyalina ngeri yonna ya kutulokola, ne tukemebwa okwerabirira ebyaffe nga tewali kirala kye tusuubira okuva gy’ali. Wabula, obulabirizi bwe, nga bw’abwanjuluza, busaana okutunuulirwa ffe ng’ekigo ekitawangulika. Kale tufube okuyiga amakulu gonna ag’ekigambo nti, emibiri gyaffe giri mu mikono gy’Oyo eyagitonda. Olw’ensonga eno oluusi yalokola abantu be mu ngeri ey’ekyamagero, ne yasukka ku kusuubira kw’abantu kwonna, nga Saddulaaki, Mesaki, ne Abdenego, okuva mu kyokero ky’omuliro, Danyeri okuva mu mpuku y’empologoma, Peetero okuva mu kkomera lya Kerode, gye yali asibiddwa, ng’asibiddwa enjegere, era ng’akuumiddwa nnyo. Mu byokulabirako bino yayagala okutegeeza nti akwata abalabe baffe, wadde nga tekirabika bwe kityo, era alina obuyinza okutuggya wakati mu kufa lw’anaayagala. Si nti bulijjo akikola; naye ng’akuumira obuyinza gy’ali okututeekateeka olw’obulamu n’olw’okufa, ayagala tuwulire nga tukakasibbwa ddala nti atukuuma; olwo buli abafuzi ab’obukambwe kye banaagezaako, era n’obusungu bwonna bwe banaatulumbisa nabwo, ye yekka alina obuyinza okuteekateeka obulamu bwaffe. Bw’akkiriza abafuzi ab’obukambwe okututta, si kubanga obulamu bwaffe tebumwagala, era nga tabussaamu muwendo emirundi kikumi ogusinga bwe gusaana. Kubanga bwe kiri bwe kityo, ng’ayogeredde mu kamwa ka Dawudi (Zabbuli 116:15) nti okufa kw’abatukuvu kwa muwendo mu maaso ge, ayogera era mu kamwa ka Isaaya (Isaaya 26:21) nti ensi erikwekula omusaayi ogulabika ng’ogukwekeddwa. Kale abalabe b’Enjiri ka basaasaanye nga bwe baagala omusaayi gw’abaffiira, balina okuvunaanyizibwa okw’entiisa ku gwo okutuuka ku ttondo lyagwo ery’enkomerero. Mu biro bino, beeyagaza mu kunyooma nga bawaayo abakkiriza mu muliro; era bwe bamala okunaaba mu musaayi gwabwe, batamiira ku gwo okutuusa lwe babala okutta kwonna kwe bakola ng’ezannyo lya masanyu bulyo. Naye bwe tugumiikiriza okulinda, Katonda alirage ku nkomerero nti si kya bwereere yasala obulamu bwaffe ku muwendo ogwa waggulu bwe gutyo. Mu kiseera kye kimu, kireme okutunyiiza nti kirabika ng’okikakasa Enjiri, eyo mu muwendo esinga eggulu n’ensi. Okusingako okukakasibwa nti Katonda tatuleka nga twerabiddwa mu mikono gy’abafuzi ab’obukambwe, ka tujjukire ebigambo bya Yesu Kristo, bw’agamba (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 9:4) nti Ye yennyini ayigganyizibwa mu bitundu bye. Katonda mazima yagamba edda (Zekkaliya 2:8) nti, "anaabakwatako anaaba akutte ku mmunye ya liiso lye." Naye wano kigambibwa bulungi ennyo, nti bwe tubonaabonera Enjiri, kiba kifaanana ng’Omwana wa Katonda ye yennyini abonaabonera mu mubiri gwe. Kale ka tumanye nti Yesu Kristo ateekwa okwerabira yekka nga tannaba kulekera okutulowoozaako bwe tuba mu kkomera, oba mu kabi k’okufa olw’ensonga ye; era ka tumanye nti Katonda alissa ku mutima okuvumibwa kwonna abafuzi ab’obukambwe kwe batukolako, wamu nga bwe kiri, ng’akukoleddwa ku Mwana we yennyini. Ka kaakano tutuuke ku nsonga ey’okubiri Katonda gy’atulangirira mu kisuubizo kye olw’okutubudaabuda. Eri nti, alitunyweza n’amaanyi g’Omwoyo we bwe kityo nti abalabe baffe, ka bakole kye basobola, wadde nga Setaani y’akulembeddemu, tebaligobamu wamu gye tuli. Era tulaba engeri gy’ayoleka ebirabo bye mu kiseera eky’obulabe ng’ekyo; kubanga obunywevu obutawangulika obulabika mu baffiira bulaga bulungi era mu bujjuvu nti Katonda akola mu bo n’amaanyi. Mu kuyigganyizibwa waliyo ebintu bibiri ebizibuwalira omubiri, okuvumibwa n’okunyoomebwa kw’abantu, n’ebibonyoobonyo omubiri bye gubonaabona. Kaakano, Katonda asuubiza okutugololera omukono gwe bwe kityo mu bujjuvu, nti tunaawangula byombi olw’okugumiikiriza. Ekyo ky’atugamba akikakasa n’ebikolwa. Kale ka tukwate engabo eno okuziyiza okutya kwonna kwe tulumbibwa, era tuleme okuziyiza omulimu gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu nsalo enfunda bwe zityo ne tulowooza nti taliwangula mangu obukambwe bwonna obw’abantu. Ku kino twafuna, mu byokulabirako ebirala, ekimu ekijjukirwa ennyo. Omuvubuka eyabeerera wano naffe, bwe yakwatibwa mu kibuga Tournay, yasalirwa omusango okusalibwa omutwe singa yeegaana, n’okwokebwa ng’omulamu singa asigala nga munywevu ku kigendererwa kye. Bwe yabuuzibwa kye yali agenda okukola, yaddamu bwereere nti, "Oyo alimpa ekisa okufa n’obugumiikiriza olw’erinnya lye, ddala alimpa ekisa okugumira omuliro." Tusaana okutwala ebigambo bino, si nga bya muntu wa lususu, naye nga bya Mwoyo Omutukuvu, okutukakasa nti Katonda talina buyinza butono okutunyweza n’okutufuula abawanguzi ku bibonyoobonyo, okusinga okutufuula okugonda mu kwagala eri okufa okusinga obukalubo. Ate era emirundi mingi tulaba obunywevu bw’awa aboonoonyi ababonaabonera ebibi byabwe. Sigamba ku bakakanyavu, naye ku abo abaggya okubudaabudibwa mu kisa kya Yesu Kristo, era olw’obuyambi bwe, n’omutima ogutereevu, ne bagumira ekibonyoobonyo ekisingayo obukambwe kye bayinza okuweebwa. Ekyokulabirako ekirungi kirabika mu mubbi eyakyusibwa ku kufa kwa Mukama waffe. Katonda, akola bw’atyo n’amaanyi ng’ayamba aboonoonyi abaavu bwe bagumira ekibonerezo eky’ebibi byabwe, alifuuka omubi bw’atyo eri abantu be, nga balwanira ensonga ye, obutabawa buvumu obutawangulika? Ensonga ey’okusatu ey’okulowoozebwako mu bisuubizo Katonda by’awa abaffiira be, kwe kubala amagoba ge basaana okusuubira okuva mu kubonaabona kwabwe, era ku nkomerero, bwe kinaaba kyetaagisa, okuva mu kufa kwabwe. Kaakano, amagoba gano gali nti oluvannyuma lw’okugulumiza Erinnya lye—oluvannyuma lw’okuzimba Ekkanisa olw’obunywevu bwabwe—balikuŋŋaanyizibwa wamu ne Mukama Yesu mu kitiibwa kye ekitaggwaawo. Naye nga bwe twogedde ku kino waggulu mu bujjuvu, kimala wano okukijjukira. Kale ka abakkiriza bayige okuyimusa emitwe gyabwe eri engule ey’ekitiibwa n’obutaggwaawo Katonda gy’abayita, balyoke baleme okuwulira nga bagayaavu okuva mu bulamu buno olw’empeera ng’eyo; era, okukakasibwa ddala ku mukisa guno ogutagerageranyizika, ka babeere bulijjo n’okufaanana kwe balina eri Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo mu maaso gaabwe; nga batunuulira okufa wakati mu bulamu, nga Ye, olw’okuvumibwa okw’omusaalaba, bwe yatuuka ku kuzuukira okw’ekitiibwa, omuli essanyu lyaffe lyonna, n’okujaguza, n’okuwangula.
